qa.q: What are the eligibility requirements to join TikTok Shop for Creators in the UK?
qa.k: eligibility, requirements, join, become affiliate, become creator, start, sign up, criteria, qualify
qa.a:
To get creator e-commerce permissions in the UK you must:
• Have at least 500 genuine followers
• Be 18 or over (confirmed via Creator Age Confirmation)
• Have posted a video in the last 28 days
• Be located in the UK, where your account is registered
• Follow the TikTok Community Guidelines
• Not use a government, politician or political party account
• Not have had creator permissions revoked before (on any account)
TikTok also notes new creators must pass the Creator Pilot Program.

qa.q: What is the minimum age requirement?
qa.k: age, minimum age, how old, 18, under 18, old enough, age limit
qa.a: You must be at least 18. New creators must complete Creator Age Confirmation within 30 days of onboarding, using a valid ID (driving licence, passport or BRP) or a valid credit card. Until you confirm, product links may be hidden and you can’t show products on your profile.

qa.q: What is the minimum follower requirement?
qa.k: followers, minimum followers, how many followers, 500, 1000, 1k, follower count
qa.a: At least 500 genuine followers (current UK rule, Sept 2026). Permissions are only lost if you fall more than 100 below that threshold. Some features have their own thresholds: the official samples guide mentions 1K+ followers for samples, and sellers can set their own sample requirements.

qa.q: Are there different eligibility requirements for different creator programmes?
qa.k: different requirements, programmes, live requirements, samples requirements, campaigns requirements, features
qa.a:
Yes. The base requirements (500 followers, 18+, posted in last 28 days, UK-located) unlock e-commerce permissions. On top of that:
• Samples: the official guide mentions 1K+ followers, and sellers can set higher thresholds
• LIVE: TikTok LIVE has its own age and follower requirements, which vary by region
• LIVE campaigns: need affiliate creator access plus LIVE permissions
• Campaigns are unavailable if your Creator Health Rating drops to 150 or below
TikTok says criteria vary by country and are updated periodically, so always check the application page.

qa.q: How do creators apply for TikTok Shop affiliate access?
qa.k: apply, application, how to apply, get access, enable shop, creator tools
qa.a: In the TikTok app: Profile → Creator tools → TikTok Shop → check the requirements checklist and apply. Once approved, create your commission account (name must match your bank account and can’t be changed later). Stripe verifies it, which usually takes up to 48 hours.

qa.q: Where can creators check their application status?
qa.k: application status, check status, approved yet, pending application, permissions status
qa.a: Check in the same place you applied (Profile → Creator tools → TikTok Shop). Once you have permissions, your access status for profile, LIVE, video and showcase is shown in your TikTok account. TikTok Shop messages also arrive in your Inbox and the TikTok Shop notification centre (top right of TikTok Shop).

qa.q: What identity verification is required?
qa.k: identity verification, id, kyc, verify identity, documents, passport, driving licence
qa.a:
Two checks:
• Creator Age Confirmation: full name, date of birth and a valid government ID (driving licence, passport or BRP), or a valid credit card
• Commission account / payouts: your verified name (must match your bank account), UK bank details, and KYC checks by Stripe (usually up to 48 hours)
If you’ve earned commission, you’ll also be asked for tax info (National Insurance Number, VAT status, date of birth) under UK MRDP rules.

qa.q: What happens if identity verification fails?
qa.k: verification failed, id rejected, age confirmation failed, kyc failed, verification error
qa.a: If you don’t complete age confirmation you won’t get e-commerce permissions, and new creators lose Creator Centre access after 30 days. If an appeal or application needs ID, submitting false, altered or incomplete documents can lead to rejection and further enforcement. If your details are genuine and it still fails, contact Creator Support from the app (Profile → ☰ → Settings and privacy → Help Centre → Chat with us).

qa.q: Can a creator reapply after being rejected?
qa.k: reapply, rejected application, apply again, try again, not approved
qa.a: TikTok Shop says that if you meet all the requirements and your application wasn’t approved, you can open a ticket to ask them to investigate. If you were rejected for not meeting a requirement (e.g. followers, or not posting in 28 days), fix it and apply again. If your permissions were revoked, you can’t get them back, including on a new account.

qa.q: What account types are eligible for affiliate access?
qa.k: account type, personal account, creator account, eligible accounts, which accounts
qa.a: Any TikTok account that meets the requirements can apply, except government, politician and political party accounts (GPPPA). The account must be accessed from the UK, where it’s registered. TikTok Shop sellers can also apply to be creators.

qa.q: Can business accounts participate in TikTok Shop affiliate programmes?
qa.k: business account, company, limited company, ltd, invoice as company, business
qa.a: Yes. If being a creator is your trade, business or profession, the Creator Terms say TikTok’s Business Terms and extra “Additional Terms for businesses” also apply. TikTok Shop’s Finance FAQ says you can only invoice as a company if your account is registered as a business account. Individual and business accounts follow different legal and tax rules.

qa.q: Can creators operate more than one TikTok Shop account?
qa.k: two accounts, multiple accounts, second account, more than one account, backup account
qa.a:
TikTok Shop’s published UK pages don’t set a simple account limit for creators. They do say:
• Creating multiple accounts to distribute the same content is prohibited as spam
• Enforcement can extend to “Associated Accounts”
• If permissions were revoked, you can’t regain them on another account
• Up to 3 TikTok accounts can be linked to the same bank card for withdrawals
If you plan to run more than one, keep the content original to each and check with Creator Support.

qa.q: What account standing requirements must creators meet?
qa.k: account standing, good standing, community guidelines, account health requirement
qa.a: You must keep following the TikTok Community Guidelines, the Creator Terms of Use and TikTok Shop UK policies. Your Creator Health Rating must stay above 0. Restrictions start at 150, and 0 means permanent removal. Under the older requirements page, accounts also needed to be “non-low quality” with no video removed in the last 28 days.

qa.q: What happens if a creator falls below an eligibility threshold?
qa.k: below threshold, lost followers, fall below, drop followers, no longer eligible
qa.a: Permissions can be restricted or suspended if you no longer meet a requirement. The exception is followers: you only lose permissions if you drop more than 100 below the 500 threshold. You’re notified through a violation ticket in Account Health / Account Standing.

qa.q: What restrictions apply to newly approved affiliates?
qa.k: new affiliate, new creator, restrictions new, beginner limits, level 0, just approved
qa.a: New creators start at Creator Level 0 and move up after their first sale. Higher levels bring more invites, higher sample approval and more campaigns. New creators also start on a Creator Health Rating of 200, must confirm their age within 30 days, and can have up to 5 sample applications at once. TikTok recommends refundable samples first, as they’re easier to get.

qa.q: What is the difference between a TikTok Shop creator account and a seller account?
qa.k: creator vs seller, seller account, merchant, own shop, difference creator seller
qa.a: A seller account lists and ships its own products through Seller Centre. A creator (affiliate) promotes sellers’ products in videos, LIVEs, photos and showcase, and earns commission. You can be both if you meet each set of criteria. Note that linking your creator account to a merchant account means you won’t earn commission on that seller’s products.

qa.q: How do creators access TikTok Shop Creator Center?
qa.k: creator center, creator centre, access creator center, find creator center, dashboard
qa.a: In the app: Profile → ☰ (three lines) → TikTok Shop Studio → TikTok Shop Creator Centre. You can also get there via Creator tools → TikTok Shop Creator Center. It’s where you find products, request samples, see collaboration invites and campaigns, and track earnings, analytics and Creator Health Rating.

qa.q: How can creators check their TikTok Shop permissions?
qa.k: check permissions, permissions status, e-commerce permissions, am i restricted, access status
qa.a: Your access to e-commerce permissions is shown in your TikTok account across profile, LIVE, video and desktop showcase, including any temporary or permanent restriction. Violations and restrictions also appear in Account Health / Account Standing.

qa.q: What causes affiliate access to be suspended?
qa.k: suspended, suspension, access suspended, why suspended, lost access
qa.a:
Common causes:
• Breaching TikTok Shop UK policies, the Creator Terms or Community Guidelines
• Creator Health Rating hitting 150, 100 or 50 (3, 7 or 14-day restrictions) or 0 (permanent removal)
• No longer meeting eligibility requirements
• Serious violations, fraud or misconduct, which can be enforced immediately

qa.q: How can a creator recover restricted affiliate access?
qa.k: recover access, get access back, restore permissions, lift restriction, regain
qa.a:
• Temporary CHR restrictions (3, 7 or 14 days) end automatically, and milestone restrictions can’t be appealed
• Raise your CHR: pass the policy quiz linked to a violation (+10, once per violation type every 30 days) and drive compliant sales (10 orders = 1 point)
• Appeal individual violations from the ticket if they were wrong. Successful appeals restore points
• Fix any eligibility gap (followers, recent posts)
Permanent removal (CHR 0 or revoked permissions) can’t be recovered on a new account.

qa.q: What is TikTok Shop's Product Marketplace?
qa.k: product marketplace, marketplace, find products, product catalogue, affiliate products
qa.a: The Product Marketplace is where TikTok Shop creators discover products to promote in videos and LIVEs. From it you can add products to your Showcase, request samples, and earn commission on sales you drive. Its “For You” section is personalised to your activity, so new creators first see popular, beginner-friendly products.

qa.q: How do creators access the Product Marketplace?
qa.k: access marketplace, where is marketplace, find marketplace, entrance affiliate products
qa.a: Go to TikTok Shop Creator Center → tap Product Marketplace in the TikTok Shop Toolkit. You can also reach it from your Showcase.

qa.q: How do creators search for products?
qa.k: search products, find a product, search marketplace, look for product, search by image
qa.a: Use the search bar in the Product Marketplace, browse the personalised “For You” categories, or use Search by image. If you can’t find a product, it may be prohibited or not added to Open Collaboration by the seller. In that case, ask the seller for the product link or a Target Collaboration.

qa.q: What filters are available when searching for affiliate products?
qa.k: filters, filter products, sort products, free sample filter, commission filter
qa.a: Officially documented filters include Free Sample / Refundable Sample (products offering samples). Seller invitations can be filtered by category, sales and Shop Performance Score. The full filter list in the marketplace changes with app updates and isn’t published in detail, so check the filter icon in your app.

qa.q: How do creators add products to their showcase?
qa.k: add to showcase, add product, showcase add, how to add products
qa.a:
You can add products:
• Directly from the Product Marketplace (tap “Add”)
• Via sample requests
• From your shopping cart or items you’ve bought
• By pasting a product URL (TikTok Shop → Add product → icon top right)
• From a seller’s Target Collaboration invite
Path: TikTok → TikTok Shop → Manage Showcase → Add Products.

qa.q: How do creators remove products from their showcase?
qa.k: remove product, delete from showcase, hide product, edit showcase
qa.a: TikTok → TikTok Shop → Manage Products → tap the 3 dots on the product → Edit / Hide / Remove. Hiding stops buyers ordering it from your showcase. Unavailable or sold-out products are removed automatically.

qa.q: How many products can a creator add to their showcase?
qa.k: showcase limit, how many products, maximum products, 2000
qa.a: Up to 2,000 products.

qa.q: What is the difference between adding a product to a showcase and promoting it in a video?
qa.k: showcase vs video, difference showcase video, showcase or video
qa.a: Your Showcase is the product tab on your profile (the basket icon), where followers can browse and buy, and you earn commission on those purchases. It also acts as your product library. Promoting in a video means attaching the product link to that video so viewers can buy from it. Products are usually added to your Showcase first, then linked in videos or LIVEs.

qa.q: What does a product's commission rate represent?
qa.k: commission rate, percentage, what does rate mean, commission percent
qa.a: It’s the percentage of the sale that the seller pays you for orders driven by your content or showcase. Commission = (Revenue − Refunds) × Commission Rate. Sellers set the rate, may set a separate Shop Ads rate, and may offer a different rate through a Target Collaboration.

qa.q: How can creators check whether a product is available for promotion?
qa.k: available to promote, can i promote, product available, eligible product
qa.a: If it appears in the Product Marketplace with an “Add” option, or in a collaboration invite, it’s available to you. On the product detail page, swipe up to see the commission rate and earning sources. Products that are sold out, under review or unavailable are removed from showcases, and sample tasks for them are paused.

qa.q: Why might a product be unavailable to an affiliate?
qa.k: product unavailable, can't add product, not available, missing product, excluded
qa.a:
Common reasons:
• It’s prohibited
• The seller hasn’t added it to Open Collaboration
• It needs seller approval
• It’s sold out or under review
• The seller has excluded you (e.g. for not posting after samples, or mostly AI content)
Third-party (non-TikTok Shop) products can’t be added at all.

qa.q: What happens if a product is removed from TikTok Shop?
qa.k: product removed, product deleted, listing removed, product taken down
qa.a: Unavailable or sold-out products are automatically removed from your showcase. Content promoting a product that’s no longer listed or available counts as low-quality content, so remove or replace those links. Sample tasks for products that become unavailable are paused or cancelled.

qa.q: What happens to existing videos when a linked product becomes unavailable?
qa.k: old videos, product unavailable video, link dead, video product gone
qa.a: The link no longer lets viewers buy. TikTok Shop’s Content Policy treats content where the product is no longer available as low quality, so it’s best to swap the link or archive the video. If a seller blocks you, their product links are removed from your existing content.

qa.q: Can creators promote multiple products in one video?
qa.k: multiple products, more than one product, several products, two products one video
qa.a: Yes. When adding a link to a video you can tap “Add more products”. Every product you link must actually be shown and promoted in the video. Linking products that aren’t shown counts as irrelevant or inconsistent promotion.

qa.q: How do creators change a product link?
qa.k: change link, edit product link, swap link, wrong link
qa.a: TikTok Shop’s UK help pages don’t document editing a link on a published video. They cover adding links before posting (Record → Next → Add link → Product) and managing showcase products (Manage Products → 3 dots → Edit/Hide/Remove). If a video has the wrong product, the safest fix is to repost with the correct link, because content that doesn’t match its linked product is a violation.

qa.q: What restrictions apply to product links?
qa.k: link rules, product link rules, link restrictions, anchor
qa.a: The product you link must be clearly shown or mentioned and match the listing exactly. No links to products that aren’t in the video, and no external, off-platform links. There are up to 25 shoppable videos and 50 shoppable photos per day. Links can be removed as an enforcement action.

qa.q: What does it mean when a product is out of stock?
qa.k: out of stock, sold out, no stock
qa.a: Customers can’t buy it until the seller restocks. Sold-out products are removed from your showcase automatically, and sample tasks for them are paused for 10 days while the seller reactivates. Avoid actively promoting out-of-stock items. Content for unavailable products counts as low quality.

qa.q: How do creators check a product's stock availability?
qa.k: stock level, check stock, how much stock, inventory
qa.a: Check the product detail page. Unavailable items can’t be added or bought. Creator-facing stock counts aren’t documented in TikTok Shop UK’s creator guides (seller video diagnosis shows stock, creator guides don’t), so if stock matters for a campaign, message the seller via TikTok Shop IM.

qa.q: Can a creator promote products from multiple sellers?
qa.k: multiple sellers, different sellers, many brands
qa.a: Yes. You can add products from any sellers that make them available to you through Open Collaboration, Target invites or product URLs. There’s no limit on how many seller invitations you can receive or accept. The only exception: if you’re linked to a seller account, you won’t earn commission on that seller’s products.

qa.q: How do creators report an incorrect product listing?
qa.k: report listing, wrong listing, incorrect listing, report product, counterfeit report
qa.a: Use the Report option in TikTok Shop instant messaging with the seller, or report suspected counterfeits to TikTok Shop. If a sample doesn’t match the description, ask the seller to resend, then contact TikTok Shop with proof if they refuse. Low-quality, damaged or counterfeit samples can be reported through the Sample Reporting Mechanism.

qa.q: How are TikTok Shop affiliate commissions calculated?
qa.k: commission calculated, how much commission, formula, calculate commission, how does commission work, earn
qa.a: Commission = (Revenue − Refunds) × Commission Rate. The estimate shown is the product’s average discounted price × rate. Final commission can differ because of coupons, discounts and refunds. The “commission base” is the GMV after discounts, taxes and other costs are deducted.

qa.q: What is the difference between estimated and settled commission?
qa.k: estimated commission, settled commission, actual commission, difference estimated, est commission
qa.a: Estimated commission is what you could earn from an order before the after-sales period ends. Settled (actual) commission is what you’re paid once the order settles. They can differ if the order is cancelled, refunded or discounted. “Not Settled” orders show £0 until they settle.

qa.q: When does commission become eligible for settlement?
qa.k: settlement, when settled, eligible settlement, settled date
qa.a: Commission is typically received on the 3rd or 15th day after successful delivery, depending on the seller’s settlement period with TikTok Shop. If the buyer requests a return or refund, settlement waits until that’s resolved.

qa.q: What factors can delay commission settlement?
qa.k: delay, delayed commission, late commission, why not settled, pending
qa.a: Disputes, refunds and return requests delay payment until they’re resolved. The seller’s settlement tier also affects timing. TikTok Shop can withhold or delay payouts where a breach of policy is suspected.

qa.q: How do refunds affect affiliate commissions?
qa.k: refund, refunds, refunded order, return commission
qa.a: Refunds are deducted: Commission = (Revenue − Refunds) × Rate. A full refund during the after-sales period means no commission, and a partial refund after receipt means partial commission. Per the Finance FAQ, if a refund happens after you’ve already been paid, that commission stays yours.

qa.q: How do cancelled orders affect affiliate commissions?
qa.k: cancelled order, cancel, cancellation commission
qa.a: If the buyer cancels before the shipment is received, or before payment, no commission is paid.

qa.q: What happens when a customer partially refunds an order?
qa.k: partial refund, partially refunded
qa.a: If a partial refund happens after the buyer confirms receipt, you get a partial commission, calculated on the revenue left after the refund.

qa.q: What happens when a seller changes the commission rate?
qa.k: rate changed, seller changed commission, commission lowered, rate change
qa.a: For Target Collaborations, changes a seller makes take effect from the next day for creators already promoting. Your estimate is based on the current rate. TikTok Shop doesn’t publish a detailed rule for Open Collaboration rate changes, so check the product’s earning details before posting.

qa.q: What is the difference between standard and campaign commission?
qa.k: standard commission, campaign commission, shop ads commission, different rates, earning sources
qa.a: The standard commission rate applies to normal sales from your content and showcase. Sellers can also set a separate Shop Ads commission rate for sales when your authorised video is used in their ads, and different rates in Target or Partner Campaign collaborations. Swipe up on a product page and tap the rate to see every earning source.

qa.q: What is the difference between open collaboration and targeted collaboration commission?
qa.k: open vs target commission, which commission, target rate, open rate
qa.a: Open Collaboration commission is the public rate any approved creator gets. A Target Collaboration is an invite-only rate set for you (often higher). If a product is in both, you get the Target rate.

qa.q: How can creators view their commission history?
qa.k: commission history, earnings history, past earnings, earnings report
qa.a: Use Creator Center → Earnings, which shows Earnings Analytics with up to 90-day windows and data from 1 Jan 2025. Download a Monthly Earnings Report (Excel) via Creator Center → Earnings → Tax files → Earnings report, generated by the 7th of each month for the previous month.

qa.q: How can creators view individual order commissions?
qa.k: order commission, each order, affiliate orders, per order
qa.a: TikTok Shop → Commissions → Affiliate orders. Each order shows ID, revenue, estimated and actual commission, order time, rate, product and status. Buyer details are hidden for privacy.

qa.q: How do creators withdraw their earnings?
qa.k: withdraw, cash out, collect payout, get money out, payout
qa.a: Creator Center → TikTok Shop Toolkit → Earnings → “Collect payout”. Confirm the account and amount, then submit. You can choose manual withdrawals or automatic withdrawals every Wednesday in Withdrawal Settings. Cross-border commissions are always automatic. If you never withdraw, TikTok Shop auto-pays every 90 days.

qa.q: What payment methods are supported?
qa.k: payment methods, bank transfer, paypal, how am i paid
qa.a: Withdrawals go by bank transfer to a UK bank account in your verified name, processed by Stripe. TikTok Shop’s UK creator guides only document bank transfer.

qa.q: What causes an affiliate payout to fail?
qa.k: bank card not working, card not working, card declined, payout failed, withdrawal failed, can't withdraw, failed payment
qa.a:
Common reasons:
• The bank account name doesn’t match your verified name
• Invalid payment details
• More than 3 TikTok accounts linked to the same card
• Missing tax information (UK MRDP), which can block payouts
• Account withdrawal restrictions

qa.q: What should creators do if a payout is missing?
qa.k: missing payout, didn't receive money, payout not arrived, where is my money
qa.a: Check Commission → Transaction → Withdrawals for the status. Timing varies by bank, but if it’s been more than 10 working days, contact TikTok Shop support. Also check the order has actually settled.

qa.q: How do creators update their payout details?
qa.k: change bank, update bank, new bank account, payout details, change card
qa.a: Delete the existing beneficiary account and add a new one: in the withdrawal area, tap the arrow → settings icon (top left) → choose the account → Delete. Then add a new bank transfer method. The name must match your verified name. Completed withdrawals can’t be reversed.

qa.q: What is the commission settlement period?
qa.k: settlement period, how long settle, days settle
qa.a: Creators typically receive commission on the 3rd or 15th day after delivery, depending on the seller’s settlement tier. Seller tiers range from Express (1 day) to Introductory/Deferred (31 days).

qa.q: How are promotional discounts accounted for in commission calculations?
qa.k: discounts commission, voucher commission, coupon commission, discount affect commission
qa.a: Commission is based on what the customer actually pays. The estimate uses the average discounted price, and coupons or discounts can lower your final commission. The commission base is GMV after discounts, taxes and other costs.

qa.q: Where can creators find official explanations of their earnings reports?
qa.k: earnings report explained, commission data explained, understand earnings
qa.a: TikTok Shop Academy has: “Your commission data explained” (Commission GMV, items sold, commission base, estimated commission), “Creator Earnings Analytics Guide”, “Monthly Earnings Report” and “Finance FAQ”.

qa.q: Do I have to pay tax on TikTok Shop commission?
qa.k: tax, hmrc, mrdp, nino, vat, self assessment, declare income
qa.a: TikTok Shop reports creator earnings to HMRC under UK MRDP. You’ll be asked for your name, address, date of birth, National Insurance Number and VAT status (Creator Center → Earnings → Tax Information), and missing info can block payouts. TikTok doesn’t collect tax for you. Whether you owe tax depends on your situation, so check GOV.UK or an accountant.

qa.q: Do I need to give sellers an invoice?
qa.k: invoice, vat invoice, seller wants invoice, receipt
qa.a: If a seller asks for one, yes, it’s your responsibility. The commercial relationship is between you and the seller, and TikTok Shop doesn’t issue invoices for you. If you’re VAT registered, include VAT. The Monthly Earnings Report includes payer details to help.

qa.q: Are there fees for earning or withdrawing commission?
qa.k: fees, charges, deductions, admin fee, withdrawal fee
qa.a: TikTok Shop doesn’t charge creators processing or admin fees on commission. Your bank may charge a service fee for withdrawals.

qa.q: Why did I earn no commission from a settled order?
qa.k: zero commission, no commission settled, 0 commission order
qa.a: Possible reasons: the order was cancelled before payment or fully refunded, your account is linked to that seller’s merchant account, or it’s your own product (no commission on your own shop’s items).

qa.q: How does TikTok Shop's free sample programme work?
qa.k: free sample programme, samples work, free samples, how samples work, gifting
qa.a:
You request a product sample from a seller. If it’s approved, the seller ships it, and you post a shoppable video or host a LIVE with it within 14 days of delivery. You keep the product. There are two types:
• Free samples: free if approved
• Refundable samples: you buy it, and the cost is refunded once your content drives the seller’s required number of orders (easier for new creators)

qa.q: How do creators request a free sample?
qa.k: request sample, ask for sample, get sample, apply sample, get sample button
qa.a: In the Product Marketplace (filter for Free Sample) or a Collab Invite, open the product and tap “Get Sample” → “Request from seller”. Add your size, contact and shipping details. Some invites auto-approve.

qa.q: What eligibility requirements apply to sample requests?
qa.k: sample eligibility, who can get samples, sample requirements, followers samples
qa.a: The official guide says any TikTok Shop creator with 1K+ followers can apply. Sellers can set their own thresholds (e.g. followers or sales), and if you don’t meet them, the request option won’t appear. You also need to keep a good Sample Fulfilment Score by posting on time.

qa.q: How many active sample requests can a creator have?
qa.k: sample limit, how many samples, five samples, 5 samples, active requests
qa.a: Up to 5 ongoing applications at once (under review, approved or pending). A creator manager can sometimes adjust this. You can only request each specific item from a seller once.

qa.q: How do sellers approve or reject sample requests?
qa.k: seller approve sample, how sellers decide, sample approval
qa.a: Sellers can approve, reject or ignore requests, either manually or with auto-approval. They choose creators most likely to drive sales, so niche fit, good content, sales history and fulfilling past samples on time all help. Sellers can also rate your sample collaborations.

qa.q: How long do sellers have to respond to a sample request?
qa.k: seller respond time, sample response, how long approve sample, waiting for approval
qa.a: For collaboration invites, the seller needs to process requests within 7 days (per the creator sample guide). Requests left unchecked for 30 days are automatically rejected.

qa.q: What happens when a sample request expires?
qa.k: sample expired, request expired, auto rejected sample
qa.a: Unprocessed requests are automatically rejected after 30 days, which frees up your request slot. You can apply again or request a similar product from another seller.

qa.q: How can creators track sample delivery?
qa.k: track sample, sample delivery, where is my sample, sample status, shipping
qa.a: Check Manage Samples / My Orders in Creator Center for the status and logistics info. Notifications also arrive in the TikTok Shop notification centre and your Inbox.

qa.q: When does the sample content deadline begin?
qa.k: deadline start, when does deadline start, 14 days from when
qa.a: From delivery. You have 14 days after you receive the sample, whether it was shipped by TikTok Shop or the seller (rule since 20 September 2023).

qa.q: How long do creators have to publish sample content?
qa.k: how long to post sample, sample deadline, 14 days, post sample video
qa.a: 14 days from delivery. The video must stay up for at least 3 days, so posting on Day 14 completes it on Day 17. You’ll get reminders 3 days and 1 day before the deadline.

qa.q: What counts as valid sample fulfilment?
qa.k: sample fulfilment, fulfil sample, what counts, valid sample video
qa.a: Either a public shoppable short video with the sample’s product link, kept up for at least 3 days, or a LIVE with the product pinned that drives at least 1 sale. If the product link is removed for a violation, it may not count.

qa.q: How many videos are required to fulfil a sample request?
qa.k: how many videos sample, number of videos sample
qa.a: The UK creator guide doesn’t require a specific number. One qualifying shoppable video (up for 3+ days), or one LIVE that drives a sale, fulfils it. Some sellers may ask for more in a collaboration, so check the invite terms.

qa.q: Can a LIVE session fulfil a sample obligation?
qa.k: live sample, livestream sample, fulfil with live
qa.a: Yes, if you host a LIVE featuring the product that drives at least 1 sale. If it doesn’t make a sale, you can post a qualifying shoppable video instead.

qa.q: What happens if a creator misses the posting deadline?
qa.k: missed deadline, late sample, didn't post sample, sample overdue
qa.a: Repeatedly missing deadlines lowers your Sample Fulfilment Score and can mean fewer sample opportunities or removal from the programme. Sellers can also auto-exclude creators who don’t post after receiving samples.

qa.q: How can creators request an extension?
qa.k: extension, more time sample, extend deadline
qa.a: TikTok Shop doesn’t offer a formal extension. The FAQ suggests asking the seller to manually mark your sample task complete (they can refuse), or contacting TikTok Shop with proof if the delay wasn’t your fault.

qa.q: What happens if a sample arrives damaged?
qa.k: damaged sample, broken sample, faulty sample, dangerous sample
qa.a: Report it through the Sample Reporting Mechanism. Damaged, faulty, dangerous or counterfeit samples count as low quality. If the report meets the criteria, you won’t have to create content for it, and your Sample Fulfilment Score isn’t affected.

qa.q: What happens if a sample never arrives?
qa.k: sample not arrived, never received sample, lost sample, missing sample
qa.a: You can cancel the sample order from its Order Detail Page (Manage Samples → select it → Cancel order) if the seller didn’t ship on time, it’s past the expected delivery time, or it’s marked delivered but you didn’t get it. Your sample quota is then restored.

qa.q: Can creators cancel an approved sample request?
qa.k: cancel sample, withdraw sample, cancel approved sample
qa.a: Before the seller ships, use “Withdraw Request”. After approval, you can only cancel if it’s delayed, unshipped or not received, via “Cancel order” on the Order Detail Page.

qa.q: How does sample fulfilment affect future sample eligibility?
qa.k: fulfilment score, sample score, future samples, sample rating
qa.a: Fulfilling samples on time raises your Sample Fulfilment Score, which increases approval chances. Sellers can also rate and review your sample collaborations. Missing deadlines can reduce opportunities or get you excluded by sellers.

qa.q: Where can creators check outstanding sample obligations?
qa.k: outstanding samples, pending fulfilment, sample reminder, samples to post
qa.a: Tap Sample Reminder or go to Manage Samples. “Pending Fulfillment” lists samples you still need to post, with the days left. “Fulfillment Suspended” shows paused tasks (e.g. if the product is sold out or under review).

qa.q: Why are my sample requests always rejected?
qa.k: sample rejected, always rejected, declined samples, no samples approved
qa.a: Sellers don’t get samples back, so they pick creators most likely to sell. To improve your chances: have content on your profile, choose products in your niche, apply early, fulfil every sample on time, and build sales. Refundable samples are easier for new creators.

qa.q: What if the sample doesn't match the description?
qa.k: wrong sample, sample different, not as described
qa.a: Ask the seller to send the correct sample. If they refuse, contact TikTok Shop with valid proof of the difference. Fake or counterfeit items can be reported through the Sample Reporting Mechanism.

qa.q: What is an open collaboration?
qa.k: open collaboration, open plan, open collab
qa.a: Products visible to all creators in the Product Marketplace. You apply to promote them (some sellers approve manually, some pre-approve you), add them to your showcase, and earn the seller’s set rate.

qa.q: What is a targeted collaboration?
qa.k: target collaboration, targeted collaboration, target plan, invite, collab invite
qa.a: A seller invites you directly, often with a custom commission rate and sometimes free samples. It appears in your inbox and Collab Invites. You accept, then add the products and create content. Invites have a “Valid Until” date.

qa.q: How do creators accept a targeted collaboration invitation?
qa.k: accept invite, accept collaboration, accept target
qa.a: Open the invite from your Inbox or Creator Center → Toolkit → Collab Invites, review the terms, accept, then add the products to your showcase and start creating.

qa.q: How do creators find invitations from sellers?
qa.k: find invites, where are invites, collab invites, seller invitations
qa.a: Creator Center → Toolkit → Collab Invites, plus the TikTok Shop notification centre and your Inbox. Invites can be filtered by category, sales and Shop Performance Score.

qa.q: How can creators contact sellers through TikTok Shop?
qa.k: contact seller, message seller, chat seller, im
qa.a: Use TikTok Shop instant messaging: on a product page tap the headset icon → TikTok Shop IM, or use the Message Centre, or “Contact seller” on a sample request. You can send text, photos and videos, rate the seller, mute or report.

qa.q: How do creators check the terms of a collaboration?
qa.k: collaboration terms, invite details, check terms, commission in invite
qa.a: Open the invite to see its details: products, commission rate (and any Shop Ads rate), free sample availability and the “Valid Until” date. Product pages also show earning sources when you tap the commission rate.

qa.q: Can creators decline a collaboration invitation?
qa.k: decline invite, reject invite, say no to collaboration
qa.a: Yes. If you’re not interested, simply don’t add the products. There’s no obligation to accept.

qa.q: How do creators leave an affiliate collaboration?
qa.k: leave collaboration, stop promoting, exit collaboration, remove collaboration
qa.a: Remove the products from your showcase (Manage Products → 3 dots → Remove) and stop linking them. TikTok Shop doesn’t document a separate “leave” button for creators. Any sample tasks you’ve accepted still need fulfilling.

qa.q: How do sellers set affiliate commission rates?
qa.k: sellers set rate, who sets commission, rate setting
qa.a: Sellers set rates per product for Open Collaboration and Target Collaboration, and can add an optional Shop Ads commission rate for ad-driven sales. TikTok Shop suggests rates, but the seller decides.

qa.q: Can sellers offer different commission rates to different creators?
qa.k: different rates creators, custom rate, personal rate
qa.a: Yes. Target Collaborations let sellers set specific rates for invited creators, and you get the Target rate if a product is also in Open Collaboration.

qa.q: How do creators access exclusive product collaborations?
qa.k: exclusive products, exclusive collaborations, premium products, invite only
qa.a: Through seller Target invites, campaign product pools in the notification centre, and higher creator levels. Higher levels typically mean more invites and access to more campaigns and premium products. Your Brand Fit tier also affects how visible you are to sellers.

qa.q: What happens when an affiliate collaboration expires?
qa.k: collaboration expired, invite expired, valid until passed
qa.a: You can accept and promote during the invite’s “Valid Until” period. TikTok Shop doesn’t publish what happens to live links after expiry, so check the product’s current commission in your showcase before promoting it again.

qa.q: How do creators check their active collaborations?
qa.k: active collaborations, my collaborations, current collabs
qa.a: Collab Invites in Creator Center lists your invites. Products you’ve accepted appear in your Showcase, and the product detail page shows the current commission and earning sources.

qa.q: What is the difference between a sample invitation and a collaboration invitation?
qa.k: sample invite vs collaboration invite, sample invitation
qa.a: A collaboration invite offers products to promote with a set commission. Some include free samples as an extra benefit, which you then request from the invite (auto or manual approval). A sample request is how you actually ask for the product.

qa.q: What happens when a seller removes a creator from a collaboration?
qa.k: removed from collaboration, seller blocked me, excluded, kicked out
qa.a: If a seller blocks you, ongoing Open and Target collaborations with them end, their product links are removed from your content, you can’t request their samples, and their products disappear from your marketplace. You can still message them. If you’re removed from an Open Collaboration pre-approved list, you can reapply but need manual approval.

qa.q: What is the Brand Fit tier?
qa.k: brand fit, tier, elite, pro, standard, basic, brand fit tier
qa.a: Brand Fit is a tier (Elite, Pro, Standard, Basic) shown to eligible sellers when they search for creators. It’s based on content authenticity (real environments, good lighting, non-AI content), product expertise, category consistency and brand safety. A higher tier means more visibility and collaboration opportunities.

qa.q: Why have I been excluded from a seller's collaborations?
qa.k: excluded from sellers, sellers excluded me, excluded, visibility affected, hidden from sellers, not getting invites
qa.a: Sellers can auto-exclude creators who repeatedly don’t post after receiving samples, or whose content is mostly low-quality AI-generated. You’ll be notified in your EC Centre. To improve: always post after samples, make authentic content and avoid inflating metrics.

qa.q: How do creators publish a shoppable TikTok video?
qa.k: shoppable video, publish shoppable, post with product, how to post product video
qa.a: Record or upload a video → Next → Add link → Product → choose from your showcase, invites, Add from Affiliate or a product URL → add a caption with product keywords and a clear CTA → post. Your account needs e-commerce permissions.

qa.q: How do creators attach a product link before publishing?
qa.k: attach link, add link before posting, add product link, yellow basket
qa.a: On the post screen: Add link → Product, then pick the product. Tap “Add more products” to add more, from My Shop, Direct Invitation, Add from Affiliate, Add from Merchant or a Product URL.

qa.q: Can product links be added to videos after publication?
qa.k: add link after posting, add link later, already posted video link
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK’s help pages only document adding links before posting. If you’ve already posted, the documented route is to repost with the link attached. You can still promote the product through your showcase.

qa.q: How many products can be linked to a single video?
qa.k: how many products per video, products per video, link limit
qa.a: You can add multiple products with “Add more products”, but TikTok Shop UK doesn’t publish a maximum. Every linked product must actually appear or be discussed in the video.

qa.q: What are the requirements for a valid shoppable video?
qa.k: shoppable requirements, valid video, video rules, what makes valid
qa.a:
• You have e-commerce permissions
• The linked product is clearly shown or mentioned and matches the listing
• The content is original and compliant (no misleading claims, off-platform links, etc.)
• Real footage, not just stills or slideshows
• Within the daily limit of 25 shoppable videos (50 photos)

qa.q: What is the difference between a shoppable video and an ordinary TikTok video?
qa.k: shoppable vs normal, ordinary video, regular video
qa.a: A shoppable video has a product link (yellow basket) so viewers can buy, and you earn commission. It’s e-commerce content, so the TikTok Shop UK Content Policy applies on top of the Community Guidelines, and it carries commercial-content expectations.

qa.q: What happens when a product link is rejected?
qa.k: link rejected, can't add link, link refused
qa.a: Links can be blocked or removed if the product is prohibited, unavailable, not in your showcase or collaborations, or from a third-party (non-TikTok Shop) platform. Links can also be removed as an enforcement action after a violation, so check Account Health.

qa.q: Why might a product link disappear from a published video?
qa.k: link disappeared, link removed, basket gone, product link gone
qa.a:
• Enforcement: removing product links is an official penalty for content violations
• The seller blocked or excluded you
• The product is no longer available
• Your age confirmation is incomplete (links can be hidden)
Check Account Health for a ticket, and appeal if it’s wrong.

qa.q: What is the product relevance policy?
qa.k: product relevance, irrelevant promotion, relevant product, irrelevant product
qa.a: Content must actually promote the linked product. “Irrelevant promotional content” is content that promotes no product, or a different product from the one linked. Examples: talking about a blender but linking a pan, or a product only visible in the background or out of focus. Show the product clearly and talk about it.

qa.q: What happens if the product shown does not match the linked listing?
qa.k: product doesn't match, mismatch, inconsistent product, wrong variant
qa.a: That’s “Inconsistent Product Promotion”, a violation. Differences in type, material, size, weight, quantity or style all count (e.g. a 3-pack vs a single, or gold vs silver). It can lead to link removal and Creator Health Rating deductions.

qa.q: Can creators link products that are not physically shown?
qa.k: link product not shown, product not in video, don't show product
qa.a: No. The product must be clearly displayed and/or verbally mentioned. Products only in the background, out of focus or not shown count as irrelevant promotion, and content without the product clearly shown is low quality.

qa.q: What are the rules for using product listing images?
qa.k: listing images, product photos, product page images, pdp images
qa.a: Avoid relying on them. Using product display page images instead of the real product counts as non-engaging. Still images and screenshots shouldn’t make up the content, and they must not cover more than 50% of the screen in LIVEs. Show the actual physical product.

qa.q: Can creators use seller-provided videos in their content?
qa.k: seller video, brand video, use seller content, provided video
qa.a: Only with permission, plus your own creative input. Reuploading content you didn’t create, with limited changes, counts as unoriginal. If you have permission, use the Content Authorization Tool so the owner confirms it, or keep an authorisation letter for appeals.

qa.q: What are TikTok Shop's rules on duplicated content?
qa.k: duplicated content, duplicate, same video, reupload, repost
qa.a: Posting high volumes of near-identical videos is treated as spam. Reposting others’ videos (or TV, film or platform clips) is unoriginal. In LIVEs, even replaying your own pre-recorded content counts as reproduced.

qa.q: What happens to product links when a video is deleted?
qa.k: delete video, deleted video link, remove video
qa.a: The link disappears with the video. Note that a sample video must stay up for at least 3 days to count. If you’re appealing a violation, don’t delete the video, or TikTok can’t review the appeal.

qa.q: Can creators promote products using photo posts?
qa.k: photo posts, shoppable photos, carousel, photo mode
qa.a: Yes, through shoppable photos (up to 50 per day). Avoid content made only of still images or screenshots without meaningful creator input, which is treated as low quality.

qa.q: How can creators check whether their shoppable video is eligible for recommendations?
qa.k: video eligible, recommendation eligible, fyp eligible, check eligibility
qa.a: TikTok says that if a video is made ineligible for the For You feed or otherwise restricted, this appears in TikTok analytics. TikTok Shop violations show in Account Health, and Video Diagnosis flags videos with “Violation”.

qa.q: What happens if a shoppable video is made private?
qa.k: private video, make private, hide video
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK doesn’t publish a rule on this. A sample video must be public and stay up for at least 3 days to count, so making it private early can fail the sample task.

qa.q: What are the requirements for disclosing commercial content?
qa.k: disclose, #ad, disclosure, commercial content, label ad
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK says the commercial nature of your content must always be obvious, and you mustn’t imply you’re just an ordinary customer. In the UK, the ASA/CAP rules also apply: affiliate content is advertising, and the ASA’s influencer guide says to label it clearly upfront (e.g. “#ad”).

qa.q: How do creators correctly label promotional videos?
qa.k: label promotional, how to label, ad label, mark as ad
qa.a: Make it clear upfront that it’s an ad. The ASA recommends a prominent label like “#ad” at the start of the caption or on screen. Use TikTok’s content disclosure setting where available. If AI is used, also label it (#AIGC or the AI toggle).

qa.q: What are TikTok Shop's creator content policies?
qa.k: content policy, creator policies, rules, guidelines, what's allowed
qa.a:
The main rules are the TikTok Shop UK Content Policy (Sept 2026) plus the creator Content Guidelines. Key areas:
• No misleading, medical or weight-loss claims
• No absolute terms without proof
• No comparisons with other brands
• No misleading prices or false urgency
• No off-platform redirects
• No dupes or counterfeits
• No content targeting minors
• Original content with the real product shown
• AI must be labelled

qa.q: What is considered misleading promotional content?
qa.k: misleading content, misleading, deceptive, false advertising
qa.a: Anything that misrepresents what the product does, its results, price, features, delivery, returns or warranty. That includes leaving out key information, unclear info, implying awards or certifications it doesn’t have, or giving the impression you’re just a customer. Claims must be genuine and provable.

qa.q: What counts as exaggerated product claims?
qa.k: exaggerated claims, overclaim, too good to be true, exaggerate
qa.a: Claims a product can’t back up: promising results it can’t deliver, presenting personal experiences in a way that suggests effects it doesn’t have, overstated beauty claims, and “best” or “No.1” without evidence. Misleading Functionality and Effect (MFE) violations can remove both the content and the products.

qa.q: What is considered unoriginal content?
qa.k: unoriginal, original content, reproduced, copied
qa.a: Short videos that reuse existing content without creative modification, such as other creators’ videos or clips from TV, film or other platforms. In LIVEs, any pre-recorded content counts as “reproduced”, even your own.

qa.q: What are the rules around reposting other creators' videos?
qa.k: repost, reposting, other creators videos, share someone's video
qa.a: Not allowed without permission. Get the owner’s authorisation via the Content Authorization Tool (you can authorise up to 5 accounts at account level) or an authorisation letter with both handles, video IDs and a signature. Even with permission, add your own creative input.

qa.q: What are the rules for using copyrighted material?
qa.k: copyright, copyrighted music, film clips, tv clips, music
qa.a: Don’t use clips from films, TV, sports or music videos without permission, because it can lead to removal. If you include someone else’s content, use only a small part, change it significantly and have written permission. Brands or logos for commercial gain need the rightsholder’s permission.

qa.q: What is considered irrelevant product promotion?
qa.k: irrelevant promotion, irrelevant product, unrelated product
qa.a: Content that promotes no product, or a different product from the one linked. For example: talking about a blender but linking a pan, a dog-print shirt linked to a cat-print listing, a product only in the background, or a LIVE with no product demo or discussion.

qa.q: What is considered low-quality promotional content?
qa.k: low quality, non engaging, low effort, poor quality
qa.a: Mostly still images, screenshots, slideshows or screen recordings. Also text-to-speech or templated narration without creator input, products not clearly shown or mentioned, products no longer available, foul language, and lots of near-identical videos.

qa.q: What are TikTok Shop's rules on misleading pricing claims?
qa.k: misleading price, price claims, wrong price, fake discount
qa.a: Prices shown or mentioned must match the live product page at posting. You can’t promote a lower price than the listing, and discounts or vouchers must be active then. Reference prices mustn’t be inflated, and price comparisons with other sellers or retailers aren’t allowed. TikTok recommends adding: “Prices may change, please note the final price is shown on the product detail page.”

qa.q: What are the rules for advertising discounts?
qa.k: advertise discount, promote discount, sale price rules, discount rules
qa.a: The discount must be active and apply at the time you post. Time-limited offers like flash sales must be clearly labelled and still valid when you post. If a price later expires, it becomes an “expired price”, so use the price disclaimer.

qa.q: What are the rules for using urgency or scarcity claims?
qa.k: urgency, scarcity, selling out, last chance, limited stock, running out
qa.a: They must be true. Claiming a seller will soon stop selling something when that isn’t the case is prohibited, as is using threatening language or moral pressure to push purchases. Genuine flash-sale end times are fine if they’re accurate when you post.

qa.q: What are the rules for promoting products that are out of stock?
qa.k: promote out of stock, sold out promotion
qa.a: Avoid it. Content where the product isn’t listed or is no longer available is classed as low quality, and sold-out products are removed from showcases automatically.

qa.q: What are the restrictions on directing customers off TikTok Shop?
qa.k: redirect, off platform, external link, amazon, website, instagram, whatsapp, qr code
qa.a: You can’t encourage buying elsewhere or share external links, websites, social handles, phone numbers, emails or QR codes in content, bios, comments or descriptions. Keep purchases on TikTok Shop through your product links. (Affiliate Linkshare is the opposite: links from outside that bring people into TikTok Shop.)

qa.q: What are the rules around making false promises about products?
qa.k: false promises, promise results, guarantee, fake giveaway
qa.a: Claims must be genuine, accurate and provable. You can’t promise results the product can’t deliver, falsely promise giveaways, prizes or free gifts, or mislead about delivery, warranty or returns.

qa.q: What are the restrictions on using misleading demonstrations?
qa.k: misleading demo, fake demo, edited demo, fake results
qa.a: Demos must show what the product really does. Don’t use edits, filters or AI to exaggerate results, change the product’s size or features, or fake movement (e.g. subtle camera shakes to make it look like it’s working). Misleading beauty filters are banned for beauty products.

qa.q: What is considered prohibited promotional behaviour?
qa.k: prohibited behaviour, banned behaviour, not allowed behaviour
qa.a: Includes: aggressive or pressuring tactics, gambling or gamification (lucky draws, spin the wheel), sexual content, targeting minors, redirecting off-platform, spam and engagement manipulation, impersonation, promoting prohibited products (even in the background), and fraud such as placing and cancelling your own orders.

qa.q: What are the rules on impersonation?
qa.k: impersonation, pretend to be, fake celebrity, impersonate
qa.a: Impersonating individuals or organisations to mislead is prohibited, including using AI to impersonate or deepfake celebrities, public figures or medical professionals to promote products. Using people’s images or names commercially needs their express permission.

qa.q: What are the rules for using fake testimonials?
qa.k: fake testimonial, fake review, testimonial, made up review
qa.a: Not allowed. Claims and experiences must be genuine and verifiable, you mustn’t pretend to be an ordinary customer, and AI can’t be used to fabricate results or personas. Manipulating reviews or ratings is prohibited.

qa.q: What are the rules around engagement manipulation?
qa.k: engagement manipulation, fake likes, buy followers, fake views, bots
qa.a: Prohibited. That includes artificially generating orders, views, likes, comments, follows or reviews, promoting artificial-traffic services, and placing and cancelling orders on your own content.

qa.q: What are the rules on making unsupported product comparisons?
qa.k: comparison, compare products, vs, versus, better than, cheaper than
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK bans comparisons with, or disparaging comments about, other products, brands, retailers or e-commerce sites in e-commerce content, and price comparisons with other sellers. Focus on what this product does and your own experience.

qa.q: What happens when a creator violates TikTok Shop content policies?
qa.k: violate policy, break rules, what happens violation, penalty
qa.a:
Possible actions:
• Removing product links or content
• Warnings
• Creator Health Rating deductions (with 3, 7 or 14-day restrictions at 150, 100 and 50)
• Restricting affiliate, campaign or TikTok Shop access
• Withholding payouts
• Permanently removing permissions

qa.q: How are violations communicated to creators?
qa.k: violation notice, how notified, violation message, warning notice
qa.a: Through a violation ticket or message in the TikTok app’s Account Health / Account Standing section and TikTok Shop notifications. The ticket explains the issue, links any policy quiz, and lets you appeal.

qa.q: How do creators view their violation history?
qa.k: violation history, past violations, see violations, violation record
qa.a: TikTok Shop → Account Health → Creator Health Rating (also on desktop). Each violation and its points are recorded there. Points reset after 90 days.

qa.q: What enforcement actions can TikTok Shop take?
qa.k: enforcement actions, penalties, punishments, sanctions
qa.a: Removing product links or content, restricting or suspending e-commerce permissions, formal warnings, restricting or suspending affiliate, campaign or TikTok Shop access, withholding payouts, terminating your account, or legal action. It can extend to associated accounts.

qa.q: What is the difference between a warning, restriction and suspension?
qa.k: warning vs restriction, suspension difference, types of penalty
qa.a:
• Warning: a formal notice with no feature loss
• Restriction: limited features for a period (e.g. no shoppable videos, LIVEs or showcase additions for 3, 7 or 14 days at CHR milestones, or posting limits)
• Suspension: temporary or permanent loss of access to affiliate features or TikTok Shop
Permanent removal of permissions is the most serious.

qa.q: Can I say a product is the best or number one?
qa.k: best, number one, no 1, best seller, absolute terms, top, market leader
qa.a: Not without proof. “No.1 in the UK” or “best-selling on TikTok Shop” isn’t allowed. Claims on the packaging, claims backed by named reports or awards, and statements about your own sales (“my top-selling product”) are fine.

qa.q: Can I promote dupes?
qa.k: dupe, dupes, inspired by, lookalike, knock off, replica, fake
qa.a: No. Copies, “dupes”, fakes, knock-offs and “inspired by” products are prohibited, even if they’re only partly similar. If the price looks suspiciously low, don’t promote it, and report it instead.

qa.q: Can kids appear in my TikTok Shop videos?
qa.k: kids, children, child, minors, son, daughter, under 18, baby
qa.a: Minors can’t promote or pitch products and can’t appear without an adult present. Content mustn’t target children or encourage them to ask parents to buy. Children’s products are fine when you’re speaking to parents.

qa.q: Can I do giveaways?
qa.k: giveaway, free gift, competition, prize, bogo, spin the wheel
qa.a: Yes, if they’re not cash, gift cards or store credit, not prohibited products, and involve no chance element (no lucky draws, wheels or mystery picks). TikTok encourages low-value prizes and using the Giveaway Tool.

qa.q: What products can't I promote?
qa.k: prohibited products, banned products, can't promote, restricted products
qa.a: Prohibited products include adult products, weapons, hazardous items, illegal drugs, financial services, medicines and medical devices, and discriminatory items. They mustn’t appear in your content at all, even in the background. Alcohol, CBD and less healthy food have extra rules.

qa.q: Do I need to show my face?
qa.k: face, faceless, no face, hands only
qa.a: Not strictly, but TikTok Shop’s guidance says not to post videos that exclude your face and the actual product, and says face-led content tends to build trust and sales faster. If you go faceless, use strong scripting, audio and visuals, and show the real product.

qa.q: Can I use text-to-speech or an AI voice?
qa.k: text to speech, tts, ai voice, robot voice, voiceover
qa.a: Be careful. Templated text-to-speech narration without meaningful creator input counts as non-engaging. In LIVEs, pre-recorded or AI voices aren’t allowed. Your own voice is best.

qa.q: How do creators appeal a TikTok Shop violation?
qa.k: appeal, appeal violation, dispute violation, challenge violation
qa.a: Open the violation message in the TikTok app and tap appeal. Give a clear explanation of why it’s wrong, plus supporting documents. Don’t delete the video during the appeal, or it can’t be reviewed.

qa.q: Where can creators submit an appeal?
qa.k: where appeal, submit appeal, appeal button
qa.a: Through the violation ticket or message in the TikTok app (Account Health / Account Standing). Community Guidelines violations have their own appeal process on TikTok.

qa.q: What evidence can be submitted with an appeal?
qa.k: appeal evidence, documents appeal, proof appeal
qa.a:
It depends on the violation. Examples:
• Unoriginal content: separate photos or videos of you in the filming setting, the same background, at least one physical product and your filming equipment, or an authorisation letter from the original creator
• Minor safety: ID proving you’re an adult
• Absolute terms: third-party data, reports or awards
• Counterfeit: trademark certificate or brand authorisation chain
Screenshots of the video aren’t enough.

qa.q: What is the deadline for appealing a violation?
qa.k: appeal deadline, how long to appeal, appeal window, appeal period
qa.a: The appeal period is stated in each violation notice. TikTok Shop’s FAQ says an appeal shows as “expired” when there’s no appeal record and the 80-day validity period has passed. Appeal as soon as you can.

qa.q: How many appeals are permitted?
qa.k: appeal twice, appeal more than once, how many appeals, appeal again, second appeal
qa.a: One per violation. If an appeal isn’t approved, you can’t submit a second appeal for the same violation.

qa.q: How long does the appeal review process take?
qa.k: appeal time, how long appeal, appeal review time
qa.a: TikTok Shop says it will reply within 7 working days while an appeal is under review.

qa.q: How can creators track the status of an appeal?
qa.k: appeal status, track appeal, check appeal
qa.a: Open the violation details. Statuses: To Appeal, Appeal under review, Appeal approved, Appeal not approved, Appeal expired.

qa.q: What happens if an appeal is successful?
qa.k: appeal approved, successful appeal, won appeal
qa.a: No further action is needed, and any Creator Health Rating points deducted for that violation are restored.

qa.q: What happens if an appeal is rejected?
qa.k: appeal rejected, appeal denied, appeal not approved, lost appeal
qa.a: The violation stands and you can’t appeal it again. You can still improve your Creator Health Rating with the policy quiz (+10) and compliant sales, and the points expire after 90 days.

qa.q: Can creators appeal an account suspension?
qa.k: appeal suspension, appeal ban, suspended appeal
qa.a: Individual enforcement actions can be appealed through their violation ticket. The automatic Creator Health Rating milestone restrictions (at 150, 100, 50 and 0) can’t be appealed. If permissions were refused or restricted, TikTok may ask for ID verification when you appeal.

qa.q: What happens when a creator accumulates violation points?
qa.k: violation points, accumulate points, points deducted, chr points
qa.a: Each violation deducts points from your Creator Health Rating (0–1,000, starting at 200). At 150 or below you can’t post shoppable videos, LIVE or add to your showcase for 3 days, at 100 for 7 days, and at 50 for 14 days. At 0 your permissions are removed permanently. Points reset after 90 days.

qa.q: How does TikTok Shop's creator enforcement system work?
qa.k: enforcement system, how enforcement works, creator health rating system
qa.a: Since March 2026, creator enforcement runs through the Creator Health Rating, which replaced the old 24-point system. Violations deduct points by severity. Quizzes, eligible orders and successful appeals add points back. Milestone restrictions apply at 150, 100, 50 and 0, and serious violations can be enforced immediately.

qa.q: How long do restrictions remain active?
qa.k: how long restriction, restriction length, suspension length
qa.a: CHR milestone restrictions last 3 days (at 150), 7 days (at 100) or 14 days (at 50). At 0 they’re permanent. Other restrictions, like AI posting limits (e.g. 15 videos in 30 days), have their own durations stated in the notice.

qa.q: Can creators continue earning commission during a restriction?
qa.k: earn during restriction, commission while restricted, still paid
qa.a: TikTok Shop doesn’t publish a blanket rule. Restrictions stop new shoppable videos, LIVEs and showcase additions. Product links can be removed from violating content, and payouts linked to a suspected breach can be withheld. Settled commission from compliant content is otherwise paid as normal.

qa.q: What happens to unpaid commissions after an account suspension?
qa.k: unpaid commission suspended, money after ban, payout after suspension
qa.a: TikTok Shop can temporarily or permanently withhold payouts from creators who violate its terms, and can withhold, cancel or deduct payouts connected to a suspected breach. It must let you know when it does.

qa.q: How can creators identify which policy caused a violation?
qa.k: which policy, why violation, reason violation
qa.a: The violation ticket names the violation type (e.g. Absolute Terms, Unoriginal Content). Open it from Account Health → Creator Health Rating. The appeal guidelines list the main violation types.

qa.q: How do creators report an incorrectly issued violation?
qa.k: wrong violation, incorrect violation, mistake violation
qa.a: Appeal it from the violation message with a clear explanation and evidence. If it’s about using someone else’s content with permission, request authorisation through the Content Authorization Tool on the ticket.

qa.q: What is the difference between a TikTok Community Guidelines violation and a TikTok Shop violation?
qa.k: community guidelines vs shop violation, two types violation
qa.a: Community Guidelines cover all TikTok content (safety, harmful content, etc.) and are appealed through TikTok’s own process. TikTok Shop violations cover e-commerce content under the TikTok Shop UK policies and affect your Creator Health Rating, and they’re appealed through the TikTok Shop violation ticket. Serious Community Guidelines breaches can also cost you TikTok Shop permissions.

qa.q: What happens when a product is removed for a policy violation?
qa.k: product removed violation, product taken down, listing removed violation
qa.a: Links to it can be removed from content, and it disappears from showcases. Sample tasks for products the seller can’t reactivate are cancelled automatically. Misleading content can lead to enforcement on both the content and the associated products.

qa.q: Where can creators find their account health or enforcement status?
qa.k: account health, enforcement status, where account health, account standing
qa.a: TikTok Shop → Account Health → Creator Health Rating (also in Creator Centre and on desktop), plus Account Standing in the TikTok app for Community Guidelines.

qa.q: What are TikTok's rules on AI-generated content?
qa.k: ai rules, ai content rules, aigc, ai generated, ai video rules
qa.a: AI content is allowed if it’s clearly disclosed and follows the rules. It’s banned to impersonate celebrities, public figures, health professionals or authorities, to exaggerate results, to misrepresent the product, or to mass-post near-identical AI videos. Also note that sellers can auto-exclude creators whose content is mostly low-quality AI, and Brand Fit scores favour non-AI content.

qa.q: When must AI-generated content be labelled?
qa.k: when label ai, must label, ai disclosure when
qa.a: Whenever AI meaningfully contributes to visuals, voices, avatars or demonstrations, even if a human edits or narrates. That includes livestreams, titles and descriptions.

qa.q: How do creators apply an AI-generated content label?
qa.k: apply ai label, ai toggle, how label ai, #aigc
qa.a: Turn on the AI-generated content setting when posting (it shows “Disclosed by creator as AI-generated”), or disclose in the content: on-screen text, a watermark, a sticker or the description (e.g. #AIGC). Official TikTok AI effects are labelled automatically.

qa.q: What types of AI-generated content are prohibited?
