qa.a:
• Undisclosed AI
• AI celebrities, public figures or political figures (even if labelled) and deepfakes
• AI doctors or health experts
• AI officials (police, government)
• Fear-based health imagery
• Exaggerated or fake results and distorted before-and-afters
• AI that changes the product’s size or features or animates it unrealistically
• Unauthorised logos
• Mass near-identical AI videos

qa.q: What are the rules on AI-generated people?
qa.k: ai people, ai avatar, ai model, ai person, digital human
qa.a: AI avatars are allowed if disclosed, but must not impersonate or resemble real people (other creators, celebrities, public figures). They can’t pose as doctors or officials. TikTok also advises avoiding avatars that resemble real people.

qa.q: What are the rules on using realistic synthetic voices?
qa.k: synthetic voice, ai voice, voice clone, cloned voice
qa.a: AI voices must be disclosed and can’t impersonate real people. TikTok Shop treats templated text-to-speech without creator input as non-engaging, and AI or pre-recorded voices aren’t allowed in LIVEs.

qa.q: What are the rules on impersonating real people with AI?
qa.k: impersonate ai, deepfake, ai celebrity, fake person
qa.a: Strictly banned. That covers AI avatars, voices or personas of celebrities, public figures, political figures, health professionals or authorities, even if labelled. Deepfakes and superimposed faces are prohibited.

qa.q: What restrictions apply to AI-generated product demonstrations?
qa.k: ai demo, ai product demo, ai showing product
qa.a: The demo must match the real product. Don’t change its size, invent features, turn 2D products into 3D, animate it unrealistically, or contradict the listing’s price, features, dimensions or accessories. Review every output for accuracy and glitches.

qa.q: Can AI-generated content be used in shoppable videos?
qa.k: ai shoppable, ai video shop, can i use ai shop
qa.a: Yes, if it’s disclosed, accurate and compliant. But bear in mind that sellers can exclude creators whose content is mostly low-quality AI, and Brand Fit tiers reward real, human-led content. Many brands prefer authentic footage.

qa.q: What are the rules on altering product appearance with AI?
qa.k: alter product ai, change product ai, edit product ai
qa.a: Not allowed if it misrepresents the product, such as changing its size, colour or features, or anything else contradicting the official product information.

qa.q: Can AI-generated testimonials be used to promote products?
qa.k: ai testimonial, ai review, fake ai review
qa.a: Not as genuine testimonials. Claims must be real and verifiable, you mustn’t pose as a customer, and AI can’t be used to fabricate results or personas. Any AI content must be disclosed.

qa.q: What happens if AI-generated content is not disclosed correctly?
qa.k: ai not disclosed, forgot ai label, no ai label penalty
qa.a: It’s a violation and products may be removed from the content. Depending on severity: posting limits (e.g. 15 videos in 30 days), traffic restrictions, suspension, withheld commission or loss of permissions.

qa.q: How does TikTok identify AI-generated content?
qa.k: detect ai, identify ai, ai label automatic
qa.a: TikTok may automatically apply an “AI-generated” label based on technical metadata, which you can’t remove. Auto-labelled content isn’t penalised just for the label. TikTok can also identify creators whose content is mostly low-quality AI.

qa.q: What are the rules on AI-generated before-and-after images?
qa.k: ai before after, fake before after, ai transformation
qa.a: Distorted or fabricated before-and-after images are prohibited. Before-and-afters for medical results (e.g. acne) or weight loss are banned regardless.

qa.q: How do TikTok's AI content policies interact with TikTok Shop creator policies?
qa.k: ai and shop policy, ai rules interact, ai community guidelines shop
qa.a: Both apply. All TikTok Shop content rules (claims, pricing, originality, minors) apply to AI content too, plus the AIGC rules on disclosure and impersonation. AI content also affects seller-facing signals like Brand Fit and seller exclusion.

qa.q: Will AI labels hurt my views?
qa.k: ai label reach, ai label views, shadowban ai
qa.a: According to TikTok Shop UK, compliant content isn’t demoted just because the AI label is on. Problems come from not disclosing, misleading results or mass low-effort AI.

qa.q: What are TikTok Shop's policies for promoting food supplements?
qa.k: supplements policy, food supplements, vitamins promote, supplement rules
qa.a:
TikTok Shop: you can mention conditions and symptoms and share general wellness tips, but you can’t say a supplement cures, treats, prevents, alleviates, “fixes” or “gets rid of” anything, even as personal experience. Approved example: “This product can boost your energy.”
UK law also applies: health claims for foods and supplements must be authorised on the GB Nutrition and Health Claims (NHC) Register, and ASA/CAP rules ban medicinal claims for supplements. TikTok’s rules don’t replace these.

qa.q: What health claims are prohibited in promotional videos?
qa.k: prohibited health claims, banned health claims, health claims not allowed
qa.a: Any claim that a product cures, heals, treats, prevents, eliminates, eradicates or alleviates a disease, medical condition, health condition or symptom, including synonyms (“fix”, “get rid of”, “go away”) and slang. Also claims that imply pharmacological, immunological or metabolic effects, or that change body structure or function.

qa.q: What are the rules on promoting weight-loss products?
qa.k: weight loss, slimming, fat burner, diet products, lose weight
qa.a: Weight-loss content is prohibited on TikTok Shop UK. That covers weight-loss claims, calories or amounts lost, before-and-after weight photos, promises that it’s easy or guaranteed, and even your own weight-loss journey. Fitness and wellness products are fine if they’re not marketed for weight loss. The ASA also has strict rules on weight-control claims for foods and supplements.

qa.q: Can creators make claims about treating medical conditions?
qa.k: treat medical condition, cure claims, medical claims
qa.a: No. Medical claims are prohibited, and medical products or devices can’t be sold on TikTok Shop. Under UK advertising rules (CAP Code), only licensed medicines can make medicinal claims.

qa.q: What are the rules on before-and-after transformations?
qa.k: before and after, transformation, results photos
qa.a: Banned for medical results (e.g. acne clearing) and weight. Elsewhere, such as cleaning or styling, they’re fine if genuine. No misleading beauty filters or AI-distorted results.

qa.q: What restrictions apply to skincare claims?
qa.k: skincare claims, skin claims, acne, eczema, rosacea, scars, collagen
qa.a: No curing, removing or reversing skin conditions (acne, eczema, rosacea, scars, melasma, hyperpigmentation, etc.), and no claims about changing the body’s structure, like boosting collagen, repairing skin cells or stimulating follicles. Talk about how skin looks and feels instead.

qa.q: What are the rules on promoting cosmetics?
qa.k: cosmetics, makeup rules, beauty rules
qa.a: Show the product’s real effect, with no misleading beauty filters. Don’t make medical or body-function claims, and avoid “best” or “No.1” without proof. Show the actual product and how it’s applied.

qa.q: What restrictions apply to hair-growth claims?
qa.k: hair growth, hair loss, alopecia, regrow, thinning
qa.a: Claims that a product cures hair loss or stimulates hair follicles are prohibited, as they’re medical or body-function claims. Focus on look and feel: shine, volume, softness, manageability.

qa.q: What are the rules on promoting vitamins and minerals?
qa.k: promote magnesium, promote vitamins, promote vitamin, vitamins, minerals, magnesium, vitamin d, iron
qa.a: You can use general, careful wording (TikTok’s approved example: “Just in case you’re not getting enough magnesium from the food you eat, magnesium supplements may be for you”). Specific health benefits must match claims authorised on the GB NHC Register. No disease claims.

qa.q: What are the rules on promoting products for sleep?
qa.k: sleep, insomnia, sleep supplement, sleep aid
qa.a: Don’t claim a product cures or treats insomnia (“Insomnia cure” is one of TikTok’s official examples of a banned claim). You can talk about a calming bedtime routine in general terms. Any nutrient health claim must be on the GB NHC Register.

qa.q: What restrictions apply to mental health claims?
qa.k: mental health, anxiety, depression, stress, mood
qa.a: Don’t claim a product treats depression, anxiety or any mental health condition (“This supplement treats depression” is an official banned example). Avoid overgeneralised mental health advice. TikTok also limits repeated recommendations of such content.

qa.q: What are the rules on promoting products related to blood pressure?
qa.k: blood pressure, cholesterol, heart health, diabetes
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK has no blood-pressure-specific page. Under the general rules, you can’t say a product lowers, treats or prevents high blood pressure or any condition. Claims about maintaining normal function are only lawful if authorised on the GB NHC Register, and blood pressure monitors are medical devices.

qa.q: Can creators use customer testimonials containing medical claims?
qa.k: testimonial medical claim, customer said cured, review medical claim
qa.a: No. Sharing personal experiences or testimonials that suggest a product cures, treats or prevents a condition is prohibited, and the content rules apply to everything you show or say.

qa.q: What are the rules on referencing healthcare professionals?
qa.k: doctor, dermatologist, nurse, healthcare professional, recommended by doctors
qa.a: Don’t imply medical authority. AI doctors or health experts are a serious violation. Don’t imply endorsements, awards or certifications a product doesn’t have. Real professional endorsements must be genuine and verifiable, and UK advertising rules also restrict health-professional endorsements.

qa.q: What are the restrictions on promoting supplements to children?
qa.k: supplements children, kids vitamins, children supplements
qa.a: Content must not target or speak to children, or encourage them to ask parents to buy. Talk to parents and guardians instead. Health claims about children’s development and health are tightly regulated under UK law.

qa.q: What is considered a misleading health claim?
qa.k: misleading health claim, health claim misleading
qa.a: Anything implying effects the product can’t deliver, such as medical claims, “misleading advice presented as fact”, unauthorised “superfood” or “detox” claims, or exaggerated results. In TikTok’s policy, general health claims must be backed by an approved GB NHC Register claim.

qa.q: What are the rules on advertising unverified product benefits?
qa.k: unverified benefits, unproven claims, can't prove
qa.a: Not allowed. TikTok Shop requires claims to be genuine and verifiable, and you must be able to support them with evidence. The ASA/CAP Code also requires evidence for objective claims.

qa.q: What happens when a creator promotes a restricted health product?
qa.k: restricted health product, prohibited health product, medicine promote
qa.a: Medicines and medical devices can’t be sold or shown. Promoting prohibited or restricted products, or making medical claims, can lead to content and product removal, link removal, CHR deductions and serious violations, up to losing permissions.

qa.q: How can creators identify whether a health product is eligible for affiliate promotion?
qa.k: health product eligible, can i promote supplement, check health product
qa.a: If it’s listed in the Product Marketplace, the seller has listed it. But you’re responsible for your content, so check it isn’t a medicine or device, read the label for permitted claims, and use only claims on the packaging or the GB NHC Register. If in doubt, don’t make the claim.

qa.q: What product-specific restrictions apply to health and wellness categories?
qa.k: health categories, wellness restrictions, cbd, alcohol, less healthy food
qa.a: Extra TikTok Shop UK guides cover supplements, beauty, weight loss, CBD, alcohol (presenters must be 25+), non-alcoholic drinks and less healthy (HFSS) food. Each adds category rules on top of the main policy.

qa.q: How do TikTok Shop rules differ from UK advertising law?
qa.k: asa, cap code, uk law, advertising law, legal requirements
qa.a:
TikTok Shop’s policies are platform rules, and breaking them leads to TikTok enforcement. UK law applies separately:
• The ASA/CAP Code covers ad disclosure (#ad) and bans medicinal claims for non-medicines
• Food and supplement health claims must be authorised on the GB NHC Register
TikTok’s guidance doesn’t cover every legal requirement. For anything high-risk, check ASA advice or get legal advice.

qa.q: What is TikTok Shop GMV Max?
qa.k: gmv max, gmvmax, what is gmv max
qa.a: GMV Max is TikTok Shop’s automated ad campaign for sellers. It optimises for the shop’s total return on ad spend (ROI) by automatically creating ads, picking the best creatives and settings, and running across the For You feed, search, the Shop tab and the TikTok Ad Network.

qa.q: How does GMV Max work?
qa.k: how gmv max works, gmv max automation
qa.a: The seller picks products (or a LIVE) and an ROI target. GMV Max then automatically creates and pauses ads, selects top-performing creatives (including authorised affiliate videos), optimises audiences, and boosts both organic and paid traffic to grow GMV.

qa.q: What is the difference between Product GMV Max and LIVE GMV Max?
qa.k: product gmv max vs live gmv max, live gmv max
qa.a: Product GMV Max promotes products to maximise non-LIVE GMV. LIVE GMV Max drives viewers into a livestream, using Video-to-LIVE and LIVE-to-LIVE creatives, to maximise LIVE revenue.

qa.q: How does GMV Max use affiliate videos?
qa.k: gmv max affiliate videos, my videos in ads, creator videos gmv max
qa.a: Authorised affiliate videos featuring the campaign products are included automatically when the seller selects “Affiliate post” as a source. Sellers can also use a video code you share. These videos get a commercial content label.

qa.q: What permissions are required for a seller to advertise affiliate content?
qa.k: permission ads, authorise seller, ad permission
qa.a: Your authorisation. Either turn on “Authorize sellers to use affiliate videos in Shop Ads” (blanket permission), toggle it per product or invite, or share an individual video code.

qa.q: How do creators authorise their videos for advertising?
qa.k: authorise videos, allow ads, ad authorisation, turn on ads
qa.a: Creator Centre → ☰ → Settings → Privacy settings → turn on “Authorize sellers to use affiliate videos in Shop Ads”. You can also do it from a product page, a Collab Invite or the Partner Campaigns product list.

qa.q: How do creators manage advertising permissions?
qa.k: manage ad permissions, ads settings, change ad permission
qa.a: In the same Privacy settings toggle, or per product on the product detail page. With the blanket toggle on, sellers can’t change your video link in their ads. With individual video codes, they can.

qa.q: Can creators revoke advertising authorisation?
qa.k: revoke ads, turn off ads, stop ads, remove authorisation
qa.a: Yes. You can turn the authorisation toggle off in Privacy settings or on a product page. TikTok’s UK guides don’t say how quickly running ads stop, so message the seller if it matters.

qa.q: What is the difference between organic and paid video distribution?
qa.k: organic vs paid, paid ads vs organic, boosted
qa.a: Organic distribution is your video reaching people through the For You feed, search and your profile. Paid distribution is when a seller spends ad budget to show it more widely. GMV Max optimises both together for the seller’s products.

qa.q: How are sales attributed to GMV Max advertising?
qa.k: gmv max attribution, attributed sales ads
qa.a: In the seller’s GMV Max dashboard, all orders for advertised products (including organic and affiliate orders) are attributed to GMV Max, with a 1-day window for same-day orders. This is seller-side reporting. Your commission still follows affiliate attribution.

qa.q: How does GMV Max affect affiliate commissions?
qa.k: gmv max commission, ads commission affect
qa.a: When your authorised video drives sales through the seller’s ads, you earn the Shop Ads commission rate if the seller set one, or the standard rate if not. That commission is paid through the affiliate programme, not from the ad budget.

qa.q: Can sellers use multiple affiliate videos in GMV Max campaigns?
qa.k: multiple videos gmv max, many creators ads
qa.a: Yes. GMV Max uses all available creative assets, including every authorised affiliate post featuring the selected products, and automatically picks the best performers.

qa.q: What happens when a creator removes advertising authorisation?
qa.k: remove authorisation effect, revoke ads what happens
qa.a: Sellers can no longer pull your videos into ads automatically. TikTok’s public guides don’t detail what happens to ads already running, so check with the seller.

qa.q: What are the requirements for videos to be eligible for GMV Max?
qa.k: video eligible gmv max, gmv max requirements
qa.a: The video must feature the campaign’s products and be authorised (via the toggle or a code). It must also comply with TikTok Shop content rules, since violating content can lose its product links. TikTok doesn’t publish further creator-side criteria.

qa.q: How can creators identify whether their content is being used in advertising?
qa.k: is my video in ads, check ads usage, ads commission earnings
qa.a: Check Earnings Analytics: “Shop Ads Commission” appears as a separate earnings component, and ad orders can be viewed by order source. Ad versions of affiliate videos also show a commercial content label.

qa.q: What is the difference between GMV Max and traditional TikTok Shop advertising?
qa.k: gmv max vs shopping ads, video shopping ads, traditional ads
qa.a: Traditional Video, Product and LIVE Shopping Ads are set up and managed more manually. GMV Max automates creatives, bidding and audiences. When a shop runs an active GMV Max campaign, overlapping Video/Product Shopping Ads for the same products are paused.

qa.q: What is ROAS in TikTok Shop advertising?
qa.k: roas, roi, return on ad spend
qa.a: ROAS (return on ad spend), which TikTok calls ROI in GMV Max, is revenue generated ÷ ad spend. Sellers set an ROI target, and GMV Max optimises towards it. It’s a seller metric and doesn’t affect your commission rate.

qa.q: How does TikTok Shop define GMV in advertising reports?
qa.k: gmv definition ads, gmv ads report
qa.a: In GMV Max reporting, GMV is the value of orders for the promoted products, counting organic and affiliate orders too. GMV from non-promoted products isn’t counted. TikTok’s ads help pages don’t give a fuller formal definition.

qa.q: How does advertising attribution work for affiliate orders?
qa.k: ads attribution affiliate, affiliate order ads
qa.a: For your commission, a purchase counts if it’s made within 7 days of a customer clicking your product link in your videos, Shop Ads, showcase or affiliate link (per TikTok Shop’s commission data guide). If your authorised video drove the sale through ads, you get the Shop Ads rate where one is set.

qa.q: What happens to advertising eligibility if a product becomes unavailable?
qa.k: product unavailable ads, ads paused product
qa.a: An unavailable product can’t be bought or promoted, and it’s removed from showcases. TikTok’s ads guides note that campaigns and ads are paused in various cases, but there isn’t a detailed creator-facing rule. Check the product is live before promoting.

qa.q: Where can creators view their TikTok Shop analytics?

qa.a: TikTok Shop Creator Center → Last 7 days data (GMV, est. commission, product views). Tap through for Video, Product and LIVE analytics, Video Diagnosis and Earnings Analytics. On desktop, Data Compass in TikTok Streamer Desktop. For audience and posting times: Business Suite → Analytics → Audience.

qa.q: What metrics are available in Creator Center?
qa.k: metrics, what metrics, creator center metrics, kpis
qa.a:
• Transaction: GMV, Direct GMV, items sold, C_O (click-to-order) and estimated commission
• Traffic: views and finished rate

• LIVE: minute-by-minute data
• Earnings: commission GMV, commission base, Shop Ads commission and bonuses

qa.q: What is GMV?
qa.k: gmv, gross merchandise value, what is gmv
qa.a: Gross Merchandise Value, the total value of orders. In creator analytics, GMV uses commission-based attribution (credit for affiliate influence on sales) and includes returns and refunds. Commission GMV counts completed and paid eligible orders.

qa.q: What is attributed GMV?
qa.k: attributed gmv, attribution gmv, direct gmv
qa.a: GMV credited to your content. Video/LIVE GMV credits a video or LIVE where the product was clicked before purchase (the 2024 metric guide says 14 days, but the 2026 commission guide uses 7 days for commission). Direct GMV only counts the last content clicked, so it’s best for judging how well a single piece of content converts.

qa.q: What is the difference between GMV and estimated commission?
qa.k: gmv vs commission, gmv commission difference
qa.a: GMV is the sales value you drove. Estimated commission is your share (sales × commission rate), which can change if orders are refunded or cancelled.

qa.q: What is product click-through rate?
qa.k: ctr, click through rate, product ctr
qa.a: The share of people who saw the product and clicked it. In TikTok Shop’s definition, product CTR = product clicks ÷ product impressions.

qa.q: How is product click-through rate calculated?
qa.k: calculate ctr, ctr formula
qa.a: Product CTR = number of product clicks ÷ number of product impressions.

qa.q: What is product conversion rate?
qa.k: conversion rate, c_o, click to order, conversion
qa.a: C_O (click-to-order rate) is the share of product clicks that turn into orders. A low C_O means people click but don’t buy.

qa.q: How is conversion rate calculated?
qa.k: calculate conversion, c_o formula, click to order formula
qa.a: C_O = number of orders for the product ÷ number of product clicks.

qa.q: What is the difference between product impressions and product clicks?
qa.k: impressions vs clicks, product impressions
qa.a: Impressions are how many times the product (card or link) was shown. Clicks are how many times someone tapped it. CTR = clicks ÷ impressions.

qa.q: What does the orders metric represent?
qa.k: orders metric, orders meaning
qa.a: The number of orders placed for products attributed to your content. In content analytics, transaction metrics like orders use the content-attribution logic. Your Affiliate orders page lists each order with its status and commission.

qa.q: How are refunded orders represented in creator analytics?
qa.k: refunds analytics, refunded orders data
qa.a: GMV and Commission GMV include refunded or returned orders, but your commission is reduced or cancelled for them. Product analytics also shows refund performance by product.

qa.q: What is the difference between video GMV and LIVE GMV?
qa.k: video gmv vs live gmv, live gmv
qa.a: Video GMV is sales attributed to your videos. LIVE GMV is sales attributed to your livestreams. Each has a “Direct” version that only counts the last content clicked before purchase.

qa.q: How can creators see which videos generated sales?
qa.k: which videos sold, video sales, top videos sales
qa.a: Creator Center → Last 7 days data → Video → Video list (sort by GMV) → Video details. Earnings Analytics → Ranking also ranks videos and products by commission GMV and estimated commission.

qa.q: How can creators view product-level performance?
qa.k: product performance, product analytics, product level
qa.a: Creator Center → Last 7 days data → Product. It shows GMV, commission, traffic and refunds per product, which channel converted (video, LIVE or showcase), and the conversion funnel.

qa.q: How can creators compare earnings across different periods?
qa.k: compare earnings, earnings over time, date range
qa.a: Earnings Analytics lets you pick date ranges of up to 90 days (from 1 Jan 2025), by order created or order settled. Analytics pages offer Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days or Custom. Monthly Earnings Reports give month-by-month files.

qa.q: How frequently are TikTok Shop analytics updated?
qa.k: analytics update, real time data, data delay
qa.a: Not real time. Video Diagnosis uses 7-day data, and Earnings Analytics defaults to settled data from the past 7 days. Monthly Earnings Reports are generated by the 7th of each month.

qa.q: Why might analytics and settlement reports show different figures?
qa.k: analytics different, numbers don't match, report mismatch
qa.a: Analytics GMV includes refunded and returned orders and uses attribution windows, while settlement only pays eligible, settled orders. Analytics can also be filtered by order created vs settled. Unpaid or cancelled orders are excluded when “Only Paid Orders” is on.

qa.q: How are affiliate sales attributed to videos?
qa.k: attribution, how sales attributed, attribution window, last click
qa.a: Purchases within 7 days of a customer clicking your product link (video, Shop Ads, showcase or affiliate link) count toward your commission metrics. Direct GMV credits only the last content clicked.

qa.q: Where can creators find historical earnings data?
qa.k: historical earnings, old earnings, past data
qa.a: Earnings Analytics (data from 1 Jan 2025, in up to 90-day windows) and the Monthly Earnings Reports (Creator Center → Earnings → Tax files → Earnings report). Reports from before the feature launched aren’t available.

qa.q: What is the difference between total orders and completed orders?
qa.k: total orders vs completed, completed orders
qa.a: Total orders includes everything placed. Completed or paid orders exclude unpaid, processing and cancelled ones. The “Only Paid Orders” filter (on by default) shows confirmed, paid orders only.

qa.q: How are cancelled orders reflected in reports?
qa.k: cancelled orders report, cancelled analytics
qa.a: Orders placed but never paid, or cancelled, aren’t included in Commission GMV and earn no commission. Untick “Only Paid Orders” to see all orders, including cancelled ones.

qa.q: What is the attribution window for affiliate commissions?
qa.k: buy later, days later, bought later, purchase later, attribution window, how many days attribution, 7 days, 14 days
qa.a: 7 days from the customer clicking your product link, per TikTok Shop’s 2026 commission data guide. An older 2024 analytics FAQ mentioned 14 days for content GMV attribution, so the 2026 figure is the current one for commission.

qa.q: What performance information can sellers see about affiliates?
qa.k: what sellers see, seller sees my data, creator analysis
qa.a: Sellers searching for creators can see your Brand Fit tier and creator insights such as performance in their category. Sellers also rate sample collaborations. Exact seller-side fields vary.

qa.q: What information is available in TikTok Shop's creator performance dashboard?
qa.k: performance dashboard, dashboard info
qa.a: An overview of the last 7 days (GMV, est. commission, product views), plus video, product and LIVE breakdowns, Video Diagnosis, earnings composition (standard commission, Shop Ads commission, rewards) and rankings of top products and videos.

qa.q: What are the requirements to sell products during a TikTok LIVE?
qa.k: live requirements, sell on live, live eligibility, go live shop
qa.a: You need TikTok Shop creator e-commerce permissions, which include promoting products in LIVEs. You also need TikTok LIVE access, which requires being 18+ and having a follower count that varies by region, plus following the Community Guidelines. LIVE campaigns also need LIVE permissions.

qa.q: How do creators add products to a LIVE?
qa.k: add products live, live products, live link
qa.a: In the app: TikTok → LIVE → Business → Add Products / Add Link. You can also do it on desktop via TikTok Streamer Desktop / LIVE Manager.

qa.q: How do creators create a LIVE product list?
qa.k: live product list, product list live, prepare products live
qa.a: Add products to your Showcase first, then add them to the LIVE before or during the stream (LIVE → Business → Add Products). TikTok also suggests having the products within reach to show them easily.

qa.q: How do creators pin products during a LIVE?
qa.k: pin product, pinned product, pin live
qa.a: Pin the product you’re talking about from the LIVE product list so viewers can buy it easily. TikTok’s FAQ path for managing products is TikTok → TikTok Shop → Manage Products → 3 dots → Edit/Hide/Remove. LIVE analytics shows the impact pinning has on revenue.

qa.q: How many products can be added to a LIVE?
qa.k: how many products live, live product limit
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK’s creator guides don’t publish a LIVE product limit (the Showcase allows up to 2,000 products). Check the app when adding products.

qa.q: How do creators rearrange products during a LIVE?
qa.k: rearrange products, reorder live products
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK’s creator help pages don’t document reordering. Pinning the product you’re currently presenting is the officially recommended way to highlight it.

qa.q: What are the rules for promoting products during livestreams?
qa.k: live rules, livestream rules, promoting on live
qa.a: All TikTok Shop content rules apply: accurate claims, correct prices, no off-platform redirects. LIVEs must also be real time, with you present and talking (or signing) to viewers, showing the actual product, with no pre-recorded content and no stills covering more than half the screen.

qa.q: What content is prohibited during TikTok Shop LIVE sessions?
qa.k: prohibited live, banned on live, live not allowed
qa.a: Pre-recorded videos or audio (even your own), TV, film or music videos, AI or robotic voices, still images or slideshows covering most of the screen, conference-call formats with no product shown, gambling or gamification, and everything else banned in the Content Policy.

qa.q: What is considered prerecorded or non-interactive LIVE content?
qa.k: prerecorded live, non interactive, looping live
qa.a: Playing pre-recorded streams or videos, pre-recorded audio, looping or slideshow visuals, or animations and games that dominate the screen, all without real-time verbal interaction. Singing, signing or playing an instrument count as real-time interaction.

qa.q: What are the requirements for a LIVE host to be present?
qa.k: host present, must be on camera, live presence
qa.a: Creators must be present and interacting in real time: greeting viewers, talking to the camera, answering comments or demonstrating the product. Livestreams without sustained real-time interaction are non-engaging.

qa.q: What happens if a LIVE receives a violation?
qa.k: live violation, livestream violation, live penalty
qa.a: Same system as other content: product link or content removal, Creator Health Rating deductions and possible feature restrictions. A reproduced-content violation for a livestream can only be appealed with Appeal Documentation (photos of you, the set, the product and the equipment), not an authorisation letter.

qa.q: How can creators appeal a LIVE-related violation?
qa.k: appeal live violation
qa.a: From the violation message in the app, like any other violation. Include separate photos or videos showing you in the LIVE setting, the same background, at least one physical product and your filming equipment. Screenshots of the stream aren’t enough.

qa.q: Where can creators view LIVE sales analytics?
qa.k: live analytics, live data, livestream stats
qa.a: Creator Center → Last 7 days data → LIVE. It shows ongoing and finished streams, minute-by-minute performance, pinning impact, purchase drivers, viewer insights and downloadable product data. Key LIVE drivers are duration, join rate, average view time, product CTR and C_O.

qa.q: How are LIVE commissions calculated?
qa.k: live commission, livestream commission
qa.a: The same way as other affiliate commission: (Revenue − Refunds) × the seller’s rate, attributed to your LIVE.

qa.q: How do creators remove products from a LIVE product list?
qa.k: remove product live, delete live product
qa.a: TikTok → TikTok Shop → Manage Products → tap the 3 dots → Edit / Hide / Remove (or via Streamer Desktop).

qa.q: What happens if a featured product goes out of stock?
qa.k: out of stock live, sold out during live
qa.a: Buyers can’t purchase it, and sold-out products are removed from showcases. Move on to another product and don’t keep promoting an unavailable one.

qa.q: Can creators schedule TikTok Shop LIVE sessions?
qa.k: schedule live, live event, plan live
qa.a: Yes. TikTok recommends creating a LIVE event (with a topic) and teasing it ahead of time, and going LIVE on a regular schedule. For key LIVE campaigns, you schedule the LIVE period with the platform when registering.

qa.q: How do creators access LIVE promotional tools?
qa.k: live tools, live vouchers, live flash deal, promo tools
qa.a: Sellers fund most LIVE promotions, like LIVE Flash Deals, Creator LIVE Flash Deals and Creator Exclusive Vouchers, which show on your LIVE automatically. You can also use billboards (on-screen text), LIVE events and platform promo codes from your account manager.

qa.q: What restrictions apply to giveaways during a LIVE?
qa.k: live giveaway, giveaway livestream
qa.a: The same giveaway rules apply: no cash, gift cards or store credit, no prohibited products, and no chance or gamification (lucky draws, spinning wheels). Don’t collect viewers’ personal details through DMs. TikTok encourages low-value items and the Giveaway Tool.

qa.q: What happens if a creator loses LIVE shopping access?
qa.k: lost live access, live restricted
qa.a: You can’t add products to LIVEs until access is restored, for example after a 3, 7 or 14-day CHR restriction ends. Check Account Health for the reason and appeal any wrongful violation.

qa.q: What is a TikTok Shop campaign?
qa.k: campaign, what is a campaign, platform campaign
qa.a: Campaigns are promotional events run by TikTok Shop or sellers, such as key LIVE campaigns, LIVE championships, short video challenges and seasonal events like Black Friday. They can offer recommended products, coupons, extra exposure and leaderboards.

qa.q: How can creators find available affiliate campaigns?
qa.k: find campaigns, available campaigns, where campaigns
qa.a: Check the TikTok Shop notification centre (campaign product pools and announcements) and the campaign tools in Creator Center. You can also register LIVE campaigns via Streamer Desktop.

qa.q: How do creators join a seller's promotional campaign?
qa.k: join seller campaign, partner campaign, join campaign
qa.a: Sellers invite creators through Target Collaborations and Partner Campaigns. Accept the invite and add the products. Partner Campaign products can carry their own commission and Shop Ads rates.

qa.q: What are the eligibility requirements for campaign participation?
qa.k: campaign eligibility, who can join campaign
qa.a: You need affiliate creator access, and LIVE permissions for LIVE campaigns. You lose campaign eligibility if your Creator Health Rating is 150 or below. Each campaign can set its own criteria, and higher creator levels unlock more.

qa.q: How do creators check campaign start and end dates?
qa.k: campaign dates, when campaign ends, campaign period
qa.a: In the campaign or invite details in the notification centre or Creator Center. Target invites show a “Valid Until” date.

qa.q: How do TikTok Shop vouchers work?
qa.k: vouchers, coupons, how vouchers work
qa.a: Buyers claim vouchers that discount their order. Seller vouchers (regular, LIVE interactive, new customer, creator exclusive) are funded by the seller. Platform promotions (shipping coupons, product vouchers, £-off discounts, Buy More Save More) are funded by TikTok Shop. Promo codes are entered at checkout.

qa.q: What is the difference between a seller voucher and a platform voucher?
qa.k: seller voucher vs platform voucher, who pays voucher
qa.a: The seller pays for seller vouchers. TikTok Shop subsidises platform (TikTok-funded) promotions, which show TikTok Shop promotion icons on product pages, LIVE, showcase and cart.

qa.q: How does free shipping work on TikTok Shop?
qa.k: free shipping, free delivery, shipping coupon
qa.a: Free shipping usually comes from shipping coupons funded by TikTok Shop, or from seller offers. TikTok Shop’s creator guides don’t publish fixed free-delivery thresholds, so check the product page. Delivery costs must be shown clearly.

qa.q: How are promotional discounts applied at checkout?
qa.k: discount checkout, apply voucher, how discounts applied
qa.a: Eligible discounts and vouchers apply on the order summary. Promo codes go in “Coupons and Promotions” → Apply → Confirm.

qa.q: How do flash sales work?
qa.k: flash sale, flash deal, countdown
qa.a: A Flash Deal is a seller-funded, limited-time offer with a countdown timer, shown on product pages, LIVE, videos and showcase. LIVE Flash Deals and Creator LIVE Flash Deals only appear on livestreams.

qa.q: What happens when a flash sale ends?
qa.k: flash sale ended, after flash sale, expired deal
qa.a: The price returns to normal. Any content still quoting the deal price becomes an “expired price”, so use the price disclaimer and avoid quoting time-limited prices in evergreen videos.

qa.q: Can creators advertise a discount before it becomes active?
qa.k: advertise discount early, pre announce sale, upcoming discount
qa.a: Not as a current price. Prices and discounts in content must match the live listing and be active when you post. You can tease an upcoming event without quoting an inactive price.

qa.q: What are the rules for advertising reference prices?
qa.k: reference price, was price, rrp, original price
qa.a: Reference prices mustn’t be inflated to mislead, all saving claims must be genuine and accurate, and price comparisons against other sellers or retailers aren’t allowed.

qa.q: How do promotions affect affiliate commission calculations?
qa.k: promotion commission, voucher affect commission
qa.a: Commission is based on what’s actually paid. Coupons and discounts can lower the final commission compared with the estimate, and the commission base excludes discounts, taxes and other costs.

qa.q: Can multiple discounts be applied to the same order?
qa.k: stack discounts, multiple vouchers, combine discounts
qa.a: Partly. Creator Exclusive Vouchers can combine with product discounts, Flash Deals and platform subsidies, but different seller voucher types can’t stack. The buyer gets the voucher with the biggest discount.

qa.q: How can creators verify the current price of a product?
qa.k: check price, current price, verify price
qa.a: Check the live product detail page just before posting. That’s the price your content must match. TikTok recommends adding: “Prices may change, please note the final price is shown on the product detail page.”

qa.q: What happens if a customer cannot access an advertised voucher?
qa.k: voucher not working, can't use voucher, voucher missing
qa.a: Vouchers can have claim periods, minimum spends and product limits. Any voucher you mention must be active and applicable when you post. If customers can’t use it, check the terms with the seller and update your content, because promoting unavailable offers can be misleading.

qa.q: How can creators check whether a promotion is still active?
qa.k: promotion active, is deal still on, check promotion
qa.a: Look at the product detail page for current promotion icons, countdowns and vouchers, or ask the seller via TikTok Shop IM.

qa.q: What are TikTok Shop's rules on misleading promotional pricing?
qa.k: misleading promo price, fake sale, inflated price
qa.a: No promoting prices lower than the listing, no inactive or expired discounts, no inflated reference prices, no comparisons with other retailers, and no claiming a product will stop being sold when it won’t.

qa.q: How do creators participate in Black Friday campaigns?
qa.k: black friday, christmas campaign, seasonal campaign
qa.a: Watch the notification centre for campaign announcements and product pools, register for platform campaigns, and use any promo codes your account manager provides (TikTok mentions Black Friday as an example). Keep all prices and claims accurate at posting.

qa.q: Why might TikTok Shop Creator Center fail to load?
qa.k: wont load, not loading, creator center broken, creator center not loading, creator centre broken, won't load
qa.a: TikTok Shop doesn’t publish an official troubleshooting list for this. Check you’ve completed age confirmation (new creators lose Creator Centre access after 30 days without it), update the app and check your connection. If it persists, contact support: Profile → ☰ → Settings and privacy → Help Centre → Chat with us.

qa.q: What should creators do if the Product Marketplace is unavailable?
qa.k: marketplace unavailable, marketplace not working
qa.a: Check your e-commerce permissions aren’t restricted (e.g. a CHR milestone restriction) and that age confirmation is done. Then update the app. If it still won’t load, contact support from the Help Centre.

qa.q: Why might a product not appear in search results?
qa.k: product not in search, can't find product, product missing search
qa.a: It may be prohibited, not added to Open Collaboration, excluded for you by the seller, or unavailable. Ask the seller for the link or a Target Collaboration, or add it by product URL.

qa.q: Why might a product be missing from a creator's showcase?
qa.k: product missing showcase, disappeared from showcase
qa.a: Unavailable or sold-out products are removed automatically, products from a seller who blocked you are removed, and third-party products aren’t supported.

qa.q: Why might the Add Product button be unavailable?
qa.k: add product button, can't add product, add button missing
qa.a: Usually because e-commerce permissions are restricted or not active (e.g. age not confirmed, or a CHR restriction blocking showcase additions), or the product needs seller approval or isn’t available to you.

qa.q: What should creators do if a product link fails to attach?
qa.k: link won't attach, can't add link, link failed
qa.a: Make sure the product is in your showcase or collaborations and still available, and that your permissions aren’t restricted. Try adding it by product URL. If it still fails, contact support.

qa.q: Why might a product link be rejected?
qa.k: link rejected, link not allowed
qa.a: The product may be prohibited, unavailable, third-party, or not available to you, or your account may be restricted.

qa.q: What should creators do if estimated commissions are missing?
qa.k: missing commission, commission not showing, estimate missing
qa.a: Check Affiliate orders and Data Compass. Orders show estimates there, and “Not Settled” orders show £0 until settlement. The “Only Paid Orders” filter hides unpaid orders. If an order is genuinely missing, contact support.

qa.q: Why might an earnings withdrawal fail?
qa.k: withdrawal failed, withdraw error
qa.a: Name mismatch with your bank account, invalid bank details, more than 3 TikTok accounts on one card, missing tax (MRDP) information, or account restrictions.

qa.q: How do creators report a technical issue?
qa.k: report bug, technical issue, report problem
qa.a: Contact Creator Support in the app: Profile → ☰ → Settings and privacy → Help Centre → Chat with us. TikTok Shop’s platform support guide covers getting help.

qa.q: How do creators contact TikTok Shop support?
qa.k: contact support, customer service, help centre, chat with us
qa.a: In the TikTok app: Profile → ☰ (three lines) → Settings and privacy → Help Centre → Chat with us.

qa.q: Where can creators find their support tickets?
qa.k: support tickets, my tickets, ticket status
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK’s creator guides don’t document a ticket list. Check the Help Centre chat history and your Inbox / TikTok Shop notification centre for replies.

qa.q: How can creators follow up on an existing support request?
qa.k: follow up support, chase ticket
qa.a: Reply in the same Help Centre chat thread and keep an eye on your Inbox and notifications. TikTok doesn’t publish response-time targets for general support (appeals get a reply within 7 working days).

qa.q: What information should be included in a technical support ticket?
qa.k: what to include ticket, support ticket info
qa.a: TikTok doesn’t publish a template. Include your username, the order, product or video ID, what happened, when, screenshots or screen recordings, and what you’ve tried. For appeals, follow the evidence requirements in the appeal guidelines.

qa.q: How do creators troubleshoot identity verification errors?
qa.k: verification error, id error, age verification problem
qa.a: Check your details match your ID exactly, use a valid ID (driving licence, passport or BRP) or credit card, and make sure your commission account name matches your bank account. If it still fails, contact support.

qa.q: What should creators do if their payout details cannot be updated?
qa.k: can't change bank, payout details stuck, update bank fails
qa.a: Delete the old beneficiary account first, then add the new one. The name must match your verified name. The OTP goes to your account’s registered phone number, so if you no longer have that number, change it in Settings or via TikTok’s feedback form. Note: tax information can’t currently be edited.

qa.q: Why might sample requests be unavailable?
qa.k: can't request sample, sample button missing
qa.a: The seller hasn’t enabled samples, you don’t meet the seller’s thresholds, you already have 5 active requests, you’ve already requested that item, you have an ongoing refundable sample for it, or the seller excluded you.

qa.q: What should creators do if an approved sample has not arrived?
qa.k: sample not arrived, approved sample missing
qa.a: If it hasn’t shipped on time, is past the expected delivery date, or is marked delivered but didn’t arrive, cancel it from the sample’s Order Detail Page. Your sample quota is restored.

qa.q: How can creators report a missing order or commission?
qa.k: missing order, missing commission report, commission wrong
qa.a: First check Affiliate orders, and the “Only Paid Orders” filter and settlement status. If something’s still missing, contact support via Help Centre → Chat with us with the order details.

qa.q: Where can creators check for official TikTok Shop platform updates?
qa.k: platform updates, policy updates, news, creator newsletter
qa.a: The TikTok Shop notification centre, the “Latest Policy Updates” and monthly Creator Policy Pulse in TikTok Shop Academy, and the Creator Newsletter.

qa.q: What is TikTok Shop's Creator Health Rating?
qa.k: chr, creator health rating, health score, account health score
qa.a: Your account health score, from 0 to 1,000. New creators start at 200. It replaced the old 24-point violation system in March 2026. Only you can see it, in Creator Centre / Account Health.

qa.q: How is Creator Health Rating calculated?
qa.k: chr calculated, how chr works, chr points
qa.a: Points are deducted for violations by severity and frequency. They’re added for passing a violation’s policy quiz (+10), eligible orders from compliant content (10 orders = 1 point, max 10 per piece of content, added on Mondays) and successful appeals. Points expire after 90 days.

qa.q: What factors affect a creator's health rating?
qa.k: affect chr, lower chr, raise chr
qa.a: Policy violations (content rules, Creator Terms, repeat breaches, evading rules, unsafe or prohibited content, illegal activity) lower it. Quizzes, compliant sales and approved appeals raise it.

qa.q: How can creators check their health rating?
qa.k: check chr, see chr, where chr
qa.a: TikTok Shop → Account Health → Creator Health Rating (also on desktop and in Creator Centre).

qa.q: What consequences can a low health rating have?
qa.k: low chr, chr consequences, chr 150
qa.a:
• 151–199: warning
• 150 or below: no shoppable videos, LIVEs or showcase additions for 3 days, and no campaigns
• 100: 7 days
• 50: 14 days
• 0: permanent removal of e-commerce permissions

qa.q: What is TikTok Shop's Creator Pilot Programme?
qa.k: pilot programme, pilot program, creator pilot
qa.a: TikTok Shop’s Top Tips page says new creators “must pass the Creator Pilot Program” to enrol as TikTok Shop Content Creators, but no UK page currently explains how it works. Check the requirements on your application screen or ask Creator Support.

qa.q: What restrictions apply to creators in the pilot programme?
qa.k: pilot restrictions, pilot limits
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK doesn’t publish specific pilot-programme restrictions. The documented new-creator limits are: start at Creator Level 0, CHR starts at 200, age confirmation within 30 days, and 5 sample applications at a time.

qa.q: How do creators graduate from the pilot programme?
qa.k: graduate pilot, pass pilot, leave pilot
qa.a: There’s no published UK documentation on graduating from the pilot. TikTok only states creators must pass it. Contact Creator Support for your status.

qa.q: What are the requirements for accessing additional affiliate features?
qa.k: unlock features, additional features, more features
qa.a: Many features scale with your creator level and track record: higher levels bring more invites, higher sample approval, more campaigns and premium products. Specific features have their own rules, like LIVE access, LIVE campaigns, and Promotion Quality Points (shown after 30 delivered orders in 90 days).

qa.q: How do TikTok Shop creator levels or tiers work?
qa.k: what level, my level, level am i, creator levels, level 0, level 1, levels, creator tier
qa.a: Creator Levels group creators by sales performance. You start at Level 0 and move up after your first sale, and levels rise with the sales you make through your content. Your level shows top-left in Creator Center. (Brand Fit is a separate tier, Elite, Pro, Standard or Basic, based on content quality.)

qa.q: What determines a creator's level?
qa.k: what decides level, level based on
qa.a: How much you’ve sold through your content, according to TikTok Shop’s beginner guide. Exact thresholds aren’t published in the UK guides.

qa.q: What benefits are associated with different creator levels?
qa.k: level benefits, higher level benefits
qa.a: Higher levels typically bring more brand and seller collaboration invites, higher sample approval rates, more campaigns and premium products, and additional creator support.

qa.q: What is a TikTok Shop product review?
qa.k: product review, product reviews, ratings, reviews
qa.a: Reviews from customers who bought the product, shown on the product page. TikTok suggests checking them before promoting something. Promotion Quality Points also use the % of positive product ratings (aim for over 97%) and shop scores.

qa.q: How can creators submit product feedback?
qa.k: product feedback, feedback seller, rate seller
qa.a: You can rate a seller in TikTok Shop IM after communicating, report sellers or low-quality samples, and message sellers directly. Sellers in turn rate your sample collaborations.

qa.q: What are the rules on promoting products from restricted categories?
qa.k: restricted categories, alcohol, cbd, hfss, restricted products
qa.a: Extra rules apply. Alcohol needs responsible promotion (presenters 25+, no health or social-success links), CBD has its own guide, less healthy (HFSS) food mustn’t target minors or promote excess, and medicines and medical devices are prohibited.

qa.q: What is Promotion Quality Points (PQP)?
qa.k: pqp, promotion quality points, quality points
qa.a: A 0–5 score based on the Shop Performance Scores and positive product ratings of what you promote, weighted by your orders. It’s available after 30 delivered orders in 90 days. Aim for 4+: choose shops scoring above 93% and products with above 97% positive ratings. TikTok says PQP is a significant factor affecting video traffic.

qa.q: What happens when a seller's shop is suspended?
qa.k: shop suspended, seller suspended
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK’s creator guides don’t cover this directly. Its products become unavailable, so they’re removed from showcases and sample tasks are paused or cancelled. Earned commission follows normal settlement. Contact support about specific orders.

qa.q: What happens to affiliate commissions if a seller closes their shop?
qa.k: seller closed shop, shop closed commission
qa.a: Not covered in the UK creator guides. Commission is deducted from the seller’s payout after settlement, so orders that already settled are paid. For unpaid orders, contact Creator Support.

qa.q: How does TikTok Shop handle commission disputes?
qa.k: commission dispute, wrong commission, dispute
qa.a: Check Affiliate orders for each order’s rate and status first. TikTok Shop’s FAQs direct anything else to support. The commercial agreement on rates is between you and the seller, and Target terms are visible in the invite.

qa.q: How can creators report suspicious seller behaviour?
qa.k: report seller, suspicious seller, scam seller
qa.a: Use the Report option in TikTok Shop IM with that seller, report counterfeit products, and contact support with evidence.

qa.q: What happens when a creator changes their TikTok username?
qa.k: change username, new username, rename account
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK doesn’t document an effect. Authorisations and collaborations are tied to your account (handle or UID), so let sellers you work with know your new handle.

qa.q: How do creators manage linked seller and creator accounts?
qa.k: linked seller, link with seller, unlink seller, bound seller
qa.a: Some invited creators can link to one authorised seller at a time. You won’t earn commission on that seller’s products. You can request to unlink, but the seller can refuse.

qa.q: What are the requirements for promoting products across different countries?
qa.k: other countries, cross border, international, eu customers
qa.a: You must use your account from the country where it’s registered. UK creators can earn “cross-border commission” on sales to customers in other markets (e.g. the EU), which is always paid by automatic withdrawal. Cross-border creators must follow both the UK and their home market’s creator terms.

qa.q: Can UK creators promote products from international TikTok Shops?
qa.k: international shops, us shop, other shop region
qa.a: UK creator permissions are for TikTok Shop UK, and the official guides don’t describe promoting other countries’ shops. What they do document is cross-border commission on sales to customers in other markets. Use the products available in your UK marketplace.

qa.q: What happens if a creator moves to another country?

qa.q: Where can creators find official TikTok Shop policy updates?

qa.a: TikTok Shop Academy’s Policy Center (“Latest Policy Updates” and the monthly Creator Policy Pulse), the in-app notification centre, and the Creator Newsletter.

qa.q: How do I keep my TikTok Shop account secure?
qa.k: hacked, security, secure account, scam, phishing
qa.a: TikTok Shop has a dedicated guide to securing your account. Never share login codes, beware offers off-platform, and don’t collect viewers’ personal details. Misusing personal information is prohibited.

qa.q: What factors does TikTok officially say influence video recommendations?
qa.k: recommendation factors, what affects fyp, algorithm factors, signals
qa.a: TikTok says recommendations use signals like what viewers watch, like, share, comment on and search for, how similar users engage, and what’s trending. Content must also be eligible for the For You feed, and rules add variety (e.g. local creators, not repeating the same sound).

qa.q: How does TikTok determine which videos appear on the For You Page?
qa.k: fyp, for you page, for you feed, how videos chosen, algorithm
qa.a:
1. It picks eligible videos that passed moderation
2. It predicts how likely each viewer is to like, share, comment or skip each one
3. It ranks them by that score
4. It swaps out videos too similar to each other
5. It applies rules (e.g. regional creators)

qa.q: How does watch time influence TikTok's recommendation system?
qa.k: watch time, retention, view duration, average watch time
qa.a: TikTok’s public documentation lists predicted interactions (likes, shares, comments, skips) and viewing behaviour as signals, but doesn’t publish a watch-time weighting. TikTok Shop’s LIVE guide says a longer average view time shows engaging content and leads to more recommendation. In Creator Center, “Finished rate” is the closest video metric.

qa.q: How do completed views and skipped videos affect recommendations?
qa.k: completion, finished views, skips, skipped, swipe away
qa.a: The system predicts the probability of a viewer liking, sharing, commenting or skipping, and ranks videos on that. Videos people skip score lower, while videos people watch and engage with score higher. Track your Finished rate in video analytics.

qa.q: What does TikTok recommend creators do when their videos receive low views?
qa.k: low views what to do, fix low views, improve views
qa.a:
• Check analytics for any For You feed restriction and Account Health for violations
• Use Video Diagnosis for specific suggestions
• Make original, real-world content with you and the product, clear audio and lighting, and real demos
• Post consistently (TikTok suggests 5–7 shoppable videos a week)
• Promote highly rated products and shops (PQP 4+)

qa.q: What is TikTok Shop's Video Diagnosis tool?
qa.k: video diagnosis, diagnosis tool, video diagnosis tool
qa.a: A Creator Center feature that analyses your videos from the last 7 days and gives suggestions to increase views and sales. It flags videos by issue (Violation, Low VV, Low CTR, Low C_O, Improve GMV) with top-3 tips on video quality, product choice and account.

qa.q: How do creators access Video Diagnosis?
qa.k: access video diagnosis, where video diagnosis, find diagnosis
qa.a: TikTok app → Creator tools → TikTok Shop Creator Center → Last 7 days data → Video diagnosis banner. You can also see it via Content Performance → Video, or on each video’s details page.

qa.q: What does the Low VV diagnosis mean?
qa.k: low vv, low video views, vv meaning
qa.a: “Low VV” means the video has low video views compared with what’s expected. The diagnosis gives suggestions under video quality, product and account to help it reach more people.

qa.q: What recommendations does TikTok provide for low-view videos?
qa.k: low view recommendations, suggestions low views
qa.a:
Video Diagnosis gives up to 3 suggestions each for:
• Video quality, e.g. which hashtags to include, or showing the product for longer
• Product, e.g. choosing branded or better-reviewed products
• Account, e.g. posting more often, or noting that your follower count is low compared with others promoting the product

qa.q: How can creators identify performance issues using Creator Center?
qa.k: identify issues, find problems, diagnose performance
qa.a: Use Video Diagnosis tabs (Violation, Low VV, Low CTR, Low C_O, Improve GMV), video details (views, finished rate, interactions, GMV), product analytics (conversion funnel, refunds) and LIVE analytics (minute-by-minute).

qa.q: What does TikTok recommend for improving video hooks?
qa.k: hooks, better hook, opening, first seconds
qa.a: TikTok Shop’s guidance focuses on creative storytelling, a problem-solving angle, trends, and being authentic. The For You feed predicts skips, so the opening needs to give viewers a reason to stay. TikTok Shop doesn’t publish a specific “hook formula”, so test different openings and check your Finished rate.

qa.q: Why does TikTok emphasise the first three seconds?
qa.k: first three seconds, first 3 seconds, 3 seconds, opening seconds
qa.a: TikTok Shop’s Still Frame guidance recommends at least 3 seconds of dynamic content (no stills or loops). More broadly, recommendations predict whether a viewer will skip, so a weak opening loses viewers before they engage. TikTok doesn’t publish an official “3-second rule” for ranking.

qa.q: What does TikTok recommend for improving viewer engagement?
qa.k: improve engagement, more likes comments, engagement tips
qa.a: From TikTok Shop’s Content Quality Guidelines: creative storytelling and humour, trending sounds or hashtags, showing how the product solves a problem, clear calls to action, and being authentic and approachable.

qa.q: How can video length affect content performance?
qa.k: how long should my video be, how long should my videos be, long videos, short videos, video length, how long video, ideal length, duration
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK doesn’t publish an ideal video length. What matters officially is engagement (predicted likes, shares and skips) and showing the product clearly. Video Diagnosis may suggest showing the product for longer. Use your Finished rate to find the length that works for your audience.

qa.q: What does TikTok recommend regarding video quality?
qa.k: video quality, lighting, audio, camera, quality tips
qa.a: Bright, high-resolution visuals, clear audio from a good mic in a quiet space, a stable camera (tripod), a clean background, synced audio and video, real demos, multiple angles and close-ups, and key selling points and price.

qa.q: How can creators identify their highest-performing videos?
qa.k: best videos, top performing videos, highest performing
qa.a: Creator Center → Last 7 days data → Video → Content Performance or Video list, sorted by GMV or Views. Earnings Analytics → Ranking ranks videos by commission GMV and estimated commission.

qa.q: How can creators use successful videos as inspiration?
qa.k: inspiration, learn from top videos, copy what works
qa.a: Video Analytics’ “Learn From Excellent Video” shows the top 3 performing videos for the same product, and Video Diagnosis suggests ways to improve. Take inspiration from the structure, but make your own original content, because copying is a violation.

qa.q: What analytics should creators review when videos underperform?
qa.k: what to check, review analytics, underperform
qa.a:
• Views and finished rate (are people staying?)
• Likes, comments and shares
• Product CTR (are they clicking?)
• C_O (are they buying?)
• Video Diagnosis labels

qa.q: How can creators analyse their target audience?
qa.k: best time to post, when to post, posting time, audience analysis, my audience, who watches, best time to post
qa.a: Video Analytics’ Audience analysis compares your viewers with your purchasers, and product analytics shows who’s interested. For when your audience is online: TikTok app → Business Suite → Analytics → Audience.

qa.q: How does TikTok recommend improving shoppable video performance?
qa.k: improve shoppable, better shoppable videos, more sales videos
qa.a:
• Quality: good lighting, clear audio, real demos
• Quantity: 5–7 shoppable videos a week, at least one a day if you can
• Timing: post when your audience is online
• Product choice: high-rated products and shops
• Originality: show your face and the real product
• Clear CTA and product-keyword captions

qa.q: What causes a video to become ineligible for the For You Page?
qa.k: ineligible fyp, not eligible for you, fyp ineligible, not recommended
qa.a: TikTok lists unoriginal or recycled content, shocking or graphic content, mature content and dangerous activities. TikTok also limits repeated recommendations of content like extreme fitness or dieting, sexual suggestiveness or overgeneralised mental health advice.

qa.q: How can creators check whether a video is eligible for recommendation?
qa.k: check eligible, is my video eligible, recommendation status
qa.a: TikTok says if content is made ineligible for the For You feed or otherwise restricted, this appears in the TikTok analytics tool. TikTok Shop violations show in Account Health, and Video Diagnosis labels them “Violation”.

qa.q: How can creators appeal an ineligible video?
qa.k: appeal ineligible, appeal fyp, appeal not recommended
qa.a: For TikTok Shop violations, appeal from the violation message with evidence. For Community Guidelines or For You feed decisions, use TikTok’s in-app appeal option shown with the notice. TikTok says it seeks to explain why content was removed or restricted.

qa.q: What happens when an account becomes ineligible for recommendation?
qa.k: account ineligible, whole account not recommended, account restricted fyp
qa.a: TikTok’s public guidance focuses on video-level eligibility, plus rules such as accounts of under-16s not being recommended. TikTok Shop restrictions can also limit shoppable features (CHR milestones) or traffic (e.g. for undisclosed AI). Check analytics and Account Health for notices.

qa.q: What does TikTok recommend for improving product click-through rates?
qa.k: improve ctr, more clicks, product clicks
qa.a: Show the product clearly and from multiple angles, explain features, benefits and price, demo it in real life, and give a clear call to action to tap the product link. Video Diagnosis flags Low CTR videos with tips. Choosing well-reviewed products and shops also helps.

qa.q: What does TikTok recommend when videos receive views but few product clicks?
qa.k: views but no clicks, no clicks, low ctr
qa.a: That’s a Low CTR problem: the content is reaching people but not making them want the product. Make the product central (not in the background), explain the benefit and price, show a real demo, add a clear CTA, and check the linked product exactly matches what’s shown.

qa.q: How can creators use Video Diagnosis to improve future content?
qa.k: use video diagnosis, improve future videos
qa.a: Review the flagged videos each week (data covers 7 days), read the top-3 suggestions for video quality, product and account, and apply them to your next videos. TikTok recommends taking these actions into account for all future content.

qa.q: What is the difference between low views, low CTR and low conversion?
qa.k: low views vs ctr vs conversion, funnel problems, low c_o
qa.a:
• Low views (Low VV): not enough people saw it, so work on hook, originality, quality and posting
• Low CTR: people watched but didn’t tap the product, so work on product focus, demo and CTA
• Low conversion (Low C_O): people tapped but didn’t buy, so check price, product reviews, shop rating and that the listing matches what you showed

qa.q: What video engagement metrics are available in TikTok Shop Creator Center?
qa.k: engagement metrics, video metrics, interaction metrics
qa.a: Views, Finished rate, New followers, Likes, Comments and Shares, plus GMV, Direct GMV, items sold and C_O, with trend charts.

qa.q: How can creators use official TikTok analytics to develop a content improvement plan?
qa.k: improvement plan, content plan, analytics plan, strategy
qa.a:
1. Weekly: check Video Diagnosis and note which videos are Low VV, Low CTR or Low C_O
2. Find your top videos (sorted by GMV or views) and their common features
3. Check audience analytics and online times
4. Plan 5–7 videos a week fixing the main issue (hook and quality, product focus or product choice)

qa.q: Why am I not getting any views?
qa.k: no views, low views, zero views, 0 views, views dropped, not getting views, nobody watching, no reach, stuck views, 200 views, flop, flopping
qa.a:
The most common reasons, from TikTok’s guidance:
• The video isn’t eligible for the For You feed (unoriginal, graphic, mature or dangerous). Restrictions show in analytics
• TikTok Shop enforcement (link removal, CHR restrictions, AI posting limits)
• Viewers skip it, because recommendations are ranked on predicted likes, shares and skips
• Low-effort formats (stills, text-to-speech, near-identical videos)
• Promoting low-rated shops or products (PQP is a significant traffic factor)
Check analytics, Account Health and Video Diagnosis first.

qa.q: Am I shadowbanned?
qa.k: shadowban, shadowbanned, shadow banned, suppressed, restricted reach
qa.a: TikTok doesn’t use the word “shadowban”, but it does make some content ineligible for the For You feed (shown in your analytics) and can restrict TikTok Shop features (shown in Account Health). If neither shows anything, the cause is more likely the content itself: hook, originality, format or product choice.

qa.q: How often should I post?
qa.k: how often post, posting frequency, how many videos week, consistency
qa.a: TikTok Shop recommends at least 5–7 shoppable videos a week, ideally at least one a day, and more in competitive niches. The maximum is 25 shoppable videos a day. Quality and originality still matter more than volume.

qa.q: How do I find winning products to promote?
qa.k: winning products, what to sell, find products, trending products, product research
qa.a:
Look for products selling now, with growing sales and not too many creators. TokMetrics updates daily:
• Trending Products: today’s top sellers
• GMV Max Radar: fast-growing products sellers are pushing
• Predictive Insights: products scored before they peak
Then check the commission rate, samples and the shop’s rating (TikTok recommends shops with a Shop Performance Score above 93% and products with above 97% positive ratings).

qa.q: What are TOF, MOF and BOF?
qa.k: tof, mof, bof, funnel, top of funnel, middle of funnel, bottom of funnel
qa.a:
Sales funnel stages:
• TOF (top): reach new people with relatable, curiosity-led content

The TokMetrics Library and AI Prompts pages can both be filtered by stage.

qa.q: Who are the top TikTok Shop affiliates in the UK?
