qa.q: How do I become a TikTok Shop affiliate in the UK?
qa.k: join, start, apply, sign up, become creator, affiliate programme, get started, eligible, how to start
qa.a:
To get TikTok Shop creator (affiliate) permissions in the UK you need to:
• Have at least 500 genuine followers
• Be 18 or over (confirmed through Creator Age Confirmation)
• Have posted a video in the last 28 days
• Be located in the UK, where your account is registered
• Follow the TikTok Community Guidelines and not have had permissions removed before
To apply, go to your profile → Creator tools → TikTok Shop and apply. Once approved you can add products to videos, LIVEs and your showcase.

qa.q: How many followers do I need for TikTok Shop UK?
qa.k: followers, minimum followers, 500, 1000, 1k, follower requirement, how many followers
qa.a:
The current UK requirement is at least 500 genuine followers to get creator e-commerce permissions. You only lose permissions if you drop more than 100 below that threshold.
Note: some features have their own thresholds. For example, the official samples guide says free product samples are for creators with 1K+ followers, and individual sellers can set higher requirements for their samples.

qa.q: How old do I have to be to be a TikTok Shop creator?
qa.k: age, minimum age, age limit, how old, old enough, 18, under 18, teenager, age verification, age confirmation, ID
qa.a: You must be at least 18. New creators have to complete Creator Age Confirmation within 30 days of onboarding, which may involve your full name, date of birth and a valid ID (driving licence, passport or BRP) or a valid credit card. Until you confirm, your product links may be hidden and you can’t display products on your profile.

qa.q: Where do I apply for e-commerce permissions?
qa.k: apply, where, creator tools, permissions, access, application, enable shop
qa.a: In the TikTok app, go to your profile → Creator tools → TikTok Shop and apply. If approved, you’ll be able to show products on your profile, add them to videos and photos, and promote them in LIVEs. You can check your status anytime in the same place.

qa.q: Why can't I get TikTok Shop creator access?
qa.k: rejected, denied, not eligible, can't apply, application failed, not approved, refused
qa.a:
The usual reasons are:
• Under 500 genuine followers
• No video posted in the last 28 days
• Not located in the UK where the account is registered
• Age not confirmed (must be 18+)
• Community Guidelines issues, or permissions revoked on a previous account
• It’s a government, politician or political party account
If you think you were refused in error, you can appeal. TikTok may ask for ID verification.

qa.q: What is the TikTok Shop Creator Centre?
qa.k: creator center, creator centre, dashboard, where find, studio, shop studio
qa.a: Creator Centre is your affiliate dashboard in the app. It’s where you find products, manage your showcase, request samples, see earnings, check your Creator Health Rating and complete Creator Tasks. Path: TikTok Shop → Profile → TikTok Shop Studio → TikTok Shop Creator Centre.

qa.q: How do I add products to my showcase?
qa.k: showcase, add product, add products, product tab, shop tab, profile products
qa.a:
In the app: TikTok → TikTok Shop → Manage Showcase → Add Products. You can add from:
• Add from Affiliate (all creators)
• Direct Invitation (target collaborations sellers invited you to)
• Add from Merchant (if a seller invited you)
• Product URL (paste a specific product link)
• My Shop (if you’re also a seller)

qa.q: How many shoppable videos can I post a day?
qa.k: limit, daily limit, how many videos, posting limit, 25 videos, 50 photos, shoppable photos
qa.a: TikTok Shop UK allows up to 25 shoppable videos and 50 shoppable photos per account per day.

qa.q: What's the difference between an affiliate and a seller?
qa.k: seller vs creator, affiliate vs seller, own shop, merchant, difference
qa.a: A seller owns the shop and lists the products. An affiliate (creator) promotes sellers’ products in videos, LIVEs and their showcase, and earns commission on sales they drive. You don’t hold stock or handle delivery as an affiliate. The seller does that.

qa.q: How is affiliate commission calculated?
qa.k: commission, how much, calculate, earn, formula, percentage, rate, how does commission work
qa.a:
Official formula: Commission = (Revenue − Refunds) × Commission Rate.
The estimated commission you see is based on the product’s average discounted price × the rate. Your final commission can differ because of coupons, discounts or refunds. Rates are set by each seller and vary by product.

qa.q: When do I get paid my commission?
qa.k: payout, when paid, payment, settlement, how long, days, delivery, get paid, money
qa.a: Commission is typically received on the 3rd or 15th day after the order is successfully delivered. The exact timing depends on the seller’s settlement period with TikTok Shop. Disputes, refunds or return requests can delay payment until they’re resolved.

qa.q: Why does my commission show £0?
qa.k: £0, zero, 0, not settled, pending, missing commission, no commission showing
qa.a: Orders on the “Not Settled” page show £0 commission because commission is only paid once the order has settled. Once it’s delivered and the settlement period passes, the commission appears.

qa.q: Do I still get commission if the customer returns it?
qa.k: refund, return, cancel, cancelled, returned, partial refund, lose commission
qa.a:
• Cancelled before delivery: no commission
• Full refund during the after-sales period: no commission
• Partial refund after the buyer confirms receipt: partial commission
That’s because commission is calculated on revenue minus refunds.

qa.q: How do I withdraw my commission?
qa.k: withdraw, cash out, bank, bank account, payout setup, stripe, KYC
qa.a: You need to verify your name (it must match your bank account and can’t be changed after submitting), add a UK bank account and complete identity checks (KYC). Payouts are processed by Stripe. If you don’t withdraw manually, TikTok Shop automatically pays out every 90 days if you have a balance, a valid UK bank account and no withdrawal restrictions. You get an in-app notice 7 days before.

qa.q: What happens if I don't withdraw my earnings?
qa.k: automatic payout, 90 days, auto withdraw, balance
qa.a: TikTok Shop will start an automatic payout every 90 days, as long as you have a remaining balance, a valid UK bank account and no withdrawal restrictions (for example, missing tax information). You’ll get an in-app notification 7 days before it happens.

qa.q: Which commission do I get if a product is in open and target collaboration?
qa.k: open collaboration, target collaboration, two rates, which rate, priority, higher commission
qa.a: If a product is in both Open Collaboration and a Target Collaboration you accepted, you get the Target Collaboration commission rate.

qa.q: What is Shop Ads commission?
qa.k: ads commission, shop ads, ad commission, spark ads, authorise, authorize, video ads, boost
qa.a: Sellers can use creators’ videos in their ads (including GMV Max). They can set a separate Shop Ads Commission Rate for sales from those ads. If they don’t, you still earn the standard commission rate when your video is boosted. You can see the rates for each product by swiping up on the product page and tapping the commission rate.

qa.q: How do I let sellers use my videos in ads?
qa.k: authorise, authorize, ad code, allow ads, video ads, privacy setting, spark
qa.a: In Creator Centre tap the 3 lines (top right) → Settings → Privacy settings → turn on “Authorize sellers to use affiliate videos in Shop Ads”. You can also toggle it on a product’s detail page, from a Collab Invite or in the Partner Campaigns product list. With the blanket toggle on, sellers can’t change your video link in their ads.

qa.q: What is GMV Max?
qa.k: gmv max, gmvmax, ads, seller ads, max, product gmv max, live gmv max
qa.a:
GMV Max is TikTok Shop’s automated ad campaign type for sellers. It promotes their products or LIVEs to maximise sales. Sellers can use creators’ authorised videos in it, and may pay a Shop Ads commission rate for those sales. Sellers who run eligible GMV Max campaigns can also get reduced platform fees.
TokMetrics’ GMV Max Radar shows products whose affiliate sales are growing fast, which is a sign of where sellers are pushing.

qa.q: How do I get free samples on TikTok Shop?
qa.k: free sample, samples, request sample, get sample, free products, gifting
qa.a:
Find a product in the Product Marketplace or a Collaboration Invite. If samples are available you’ll see a “Get Sample” button. You can filter for Free Sample and Refundable Sample. Tap “Request from seller” and add your size, contact and shipping details.
The official guide says creators with 1K+ followers can apply, and sellers can set their own thresholds and approve, reject or ignore requests.

qa.q: How long do I have to post after getting a sample?
qa.k: deadline, 14 days, post sample, sample video, how long, sample rules
qa.a: You have 14 days from delivery to post, and the video must stay up for at least 3 days. Day 14 is the latest you can post, which completes the requirement on Day 17. You can post a public shoppable video, or host a LIVE that drives at least 1 sale. You’ll get reminders 3 days and 1 day before the deadline.

qa.q: What happens if I don't post after receiving a sample?
qa.k: didn't post, missed deadline, not posting sample, penalty sample
qa.a: Repeatedly missing sample deadlines can mean fewer sample opportunities, or being removed from the samples programme.

qa.q: How many samples can I request at once?
qa.k: sample limit, how many samples, five, 5 samples, ongoing
qa.a: You can have up to 5 ongoing sample applications at once (a creator manager can sometimes adjust this). You can only request each specific item from a seller once, but you can request different items from the same seller, or similar items from different sellers.

qa.q: Why was my sample request rejected?
qa.k: rejected sample, declined, ignored, no response, sample denied, auto rejected
qa.a: Sellers can approve, reject or ignore requests and set their own requirements (for example followers or past sales). Requests a seller leaves unchecked for 30 days are automatically rejected. Your best chance is to choose products that match your niche, and to have recent sales and good content in that category.

qa.q: What's the difference between open and target collaboration?
qa.k: open collaboration, target collaboration, targeted, invite, collab invite, plan
qa.a:
• Open Collaboration: products anyone can apply to promote from the Product Marketplace. Some sellers need to approve you first.
• Target Collaboration: a seller invites you directly with a set commission (often higher). It appears in your inbox, and you accept before promoting. Invites have a “Valid Until” date.

qa.q: How do I get brands to invite me?
qa.k: brand deals, invites, sellers find me, get noticed, target invite, collabs
qa.a: Sellers search for creators by niche, followers, sales and content quality, then send Target Collaboration invites. Keep a clear niche, post consistently, and turn on authorisation for your videos to be used in Shop Ads. This makes your content more valuable to sellers. Strong sales in a category also help you get pre-approved and invited.

qa.q: What are Creator Tasks?
qa.k: tasks, rewards, sample vouchers, growth tab, challenges
qa.a: Creator Tasks are mini challenges in Creator Centre’s Growth tab, like going LIVE for a set time, posting videos or hitting sales targets. They reward you with things like sample vouchers, plus tips. Each task has its own instructions, deadline and sometimes a specific product pool.

qa.q: What can't I say in TikTok Shop videos?
qa.k: banned words, not allowed, rules, violations, what to avoid, content policy, can't say
qa.a:
The big ones in the UK Content Policy:
• Medical claims: “cures”, “treats”, “gets rid of”, “fixes” a condition
• Weight loss claims of any kind
• Absolute terms like “No.1 in the UK” or “best seller on TikTok Shop” without proof
• Comparing the product to other brands, products or retailers
• Misleading prices, or saying a product will stop being sold when it won’t
• Sending people off TikTok (links, website, Instagram, WhatsApp, QR codes)
• Dupes, knock-offs or unauthorised brand names
• Targeting under-18s
TokMetrics’ hooks and scripts library is a good starting point for wording.

qa.q: Can I compare a product to another brand?
qa.k: comparison, compare, vs, versus, big brand, dupe, cheaper than, better than
qa.a:
No. The UK Content Policy says e-commerce content must not contain comparisons with, or disparaging comments about, other products, brands, retailers or e-commerce sites. Price comparisons against other sellers or retailers aren’t allowed either.
Instead, focus on what this product does, your own experience and its price on TikTok Shop.

qa.q: Can I mention the price or a discount in my video?
qa.k: price, discount, sale price, offer, flash sale, voucher, how much, mention price
qa.a: Yes, but it must match the live product page at the time you post, and any discount or voucher must be active then. Flash sales must be clearly labelled as time-limited. TikTok recommends adding: “Disclaimer: Prices may change, please note the final price is shown on the product detail page.”

qa.q: Can I say a product is selling out or about to stop being sold?
qa.k: selling out, last chance, stock, urgency, scarcity, limited, running out, stop selling
qa.a: Only if it’s true. The Content Policy prohibits claiming a seller will soon stop selling a product when that isn’t the case, and anything misleading about price, stock or offers. Genuine urgency like “the flash sale ends tonight” is fine if it’s accurate when you post.

qa.q: Can I tell people to buy it on Amazon or my website?
qa.k: amazon, website, link in bio, instagram, whatsapp, off platform, redirect, external link, QR
qa.a: No. That’s “redirecting traffic” and is penalised. Don’t mention other websites, apps, social handles, phone numbers, emails or QR codes, or tell people to buy elsewhere. Keep it to the product link or yellow basket in your video, LIVE or showcase.

qa.q: Can I repost someone else's video?
qa.k: repost, reupload, steal, other creator, unoriginal, reproduced, copy video, duplicate
qa.a: No. Uploading other creators’ content, or clips from TV, films or other platforms, counts as unoriginal content. In LIVEs, even playing your own pre-recorded videos or audio counts as reproduced content. Make your own original content.

qa.q: Can I use still images or slideshows?
qa.k: slideshow, photos, still image, screenshots, static, no face, product only
qa.a: Avoid relying on them. TikTok Shop’s Still Frame guidance says not to post videos made only of stills, looping or scrolling images, or videos that exclude your face and the actual product. Aim for real-world footage with movement. Show yourself and the physical product, with at least 3 seconds of dynamic content.

qa.q: Do I need to say it's an ad?
qa.k: ad, advert, #ad, disclose, sponsored, commercial, gifted, paid
qa.a: The UK Content Policy says the commercial nature of your content must always be obviously identifiable, and you must not give the impression you’re just a regular customer when you’re promoting it. Clear product links help, and being upfront that you earn commission keeps you on the right side of the rules.

qa.q: Can I promote weight loss products?
qa.k: weight loss, slimming, fat burner, diet, lose weight, appetite, calories, before after weight

qa.q: Does the product in my video have to match the listing exactly?
qa.k: wrong product, different colour, size, inconsistent, mismatch, variant

qa.q: What health claims can I make about supplements?

Don’t say a product cures, heals, removes or reverses skin conditions like acne, eczema, rosacea, scars, melasma or hyperpigmentation. Also don’t claim it changes the body’s structure, like boosting collagen production, repairing skin cells or stimulating hair follicles. qa.q: What words should I avoid for health and beauty products?

qa.q: Can I call a food a superfood or say it detoxes?

qa.q: What is Creator Health Rating?
qa.k: chr, creator health rating, health score, account health, points, score
qa.a: Creator Health Rating (CHR) is a score from 0 to 1,000 that shows your account health. It replaced the old 24-point violation system in March 2026, and new creators start at 200. It goes down for violations and up for passing policy quizzes (+10) and for eligible orders (1 point per 10 orders from compliant content, max 10 per piece of content). Points last 90 days. You can see it in Creator Centre. Only you can see it.

qa.q: What happens if my Creator Health Rating drops?

qa.a:
• 200–1,000: healthy
• 151–199: warning (needs improvement)
• 150 or below: no shoppable videos, LIVEs or showcase additions for 3 days, and no campaigns
• 100 or below: same restrictions for 7 days
• 50 or below: same restrictions for 14 days
• 0: e-commerce permissions permanently removed
Serious violations can be enforced immediately, whatever your score.

qa.k: appeal, violation, wrong, mistake, unfair, removed video, dispute

qa.q: How does the TikTok algorithm work?
qa.k: algorithm, fyp, for you page, for you feed, recommendation, how videos get pushed, get pushed, how tiktok decides
qa.a:
According to TikTok, the For You feed:
1. Picks videos that passed moderation and are eligible for recommendation
2. Predicts how likely each viewer is to like, share, comment or skip them, based on what they’ve watched, liked and shared, and what similar viewers engaged with
3. Ranks the videos by that score
4. Swaps out videos that are too similar to each other, e.g. the same sound back to back
5. Applies rules, like including creators from the viewer’s region
So what matters most is whether your video makes viewers stop, watch and interact.
